jobs.title: Program Coordinator - YAWL Work Based Learning
jobs.description:
**JOB ANNOUNCEMENT**


The Community Youth Center of San Francisco (CYC) provides the youth of our city a sense of belonging and vital tools and experiences to succeed in life. Our services include academic support and college counseling, job placement and employment training, substance use and violence prevention education, crisis intervention and mediation, leadership development, technology and computer training. Our mission is to encourage a diverse population of high\-need young people to explore their full potential through academic, career, family, and community life.

 **Title:****Program Coordinator \- YAWL Work Based Learning**

**Salary:****$30\.00 \- $34\.00 per hour plus excellent benefits**

**Reports to:****Program Supervisor**

**Status:****Full\-Time, (40 hours/week), Non\-Exempt**  

  

**Program Summary:** CYC’s YAWL Workforce Development Program provides job readiness and employment support services to youth ages 16\-24\. The program offers 1:1 job search and career coaching, work based learning internships, college and career exploration, and job shadowing opportunities to propel youth and young adults to be ready for college, work and reach productive adulthood.  

  

**Position Description:** Under the supervision of the Program Supervisor, the Program Coordinator is responsible for overseeing the Work Based Learning portfolio, supervising staff, overseeing workshops/trainings, establishing best practice program models, and providing high quality youth workforce and development services.

 **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Oversee the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Young Adult Work Link program and comprehensive service delivery model.
* Develop policy and procedure recommendations to strengthen the program model and collaboration among grantee and coalition partners.
* Ensure program development and service delivery align with “Youth Program Quality Standards” and meet all “Work Plan” deliverables and deadlines.
* Complete all required documentation, reports, and program deliverables in a timely manner.
* Lead citywide outreach and recruitment efforts, cultivating strategic community partnerships and developing a robust referral network to support recruitment and engagement, with a focus on priority populations.
* Develop and facilitate job readiness training workshops, including but not limited to professionalism, career exploration, resume and cover letter building, job search/navigation, interview skill development, mock interviews, and strength/talent identification.
* Coordinate subsidized internships, recruiting local SF businesses/employers to partner as a worksite and provide support to worksite supervisors and participants throughout the internship period.
* Conduct participant assessments and provide intensive case management, wraparound supportive services, and guidance to address barriers affecting work and school performance.
* Develop individualized vocational goals and career plans using vocational and interest assessments, and provide personal and career guidance.
* Coordinate GED attainment, tutoring, basic skills remediation, postsecondary education, and workforce training services.
* Provide 1:1 career guidance and assist participants with individualized education and career planning services, job search and placement assistance and conduct follow ups for retention services.
* Connect participants to resources within CYC and other CBO or city services for barrier removal to ensure their success.
* Supervise, support, coach and train Program Specialists in job readiness training content, career counseling, outreach, funder databases, and other duties as applicable.
* Collaborate with the workforce team to strategize on program planning, development and implementation of overall youth workforce development programs and outcomes.
* Partnerships/Event Planning
* Coordinate career exploration events and adult mentoring opportunities such as worksite/company tours, college tours, and networking events for program participants
* Support agency\-wide events and perform other duties as assigned by management.

 **QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in relevant field.
* Experience working with diverse youth backgrounds, preferably within youth workforce development programs.
* Previous experience in program coordination, internship coordination, and development
* Ability to work with ethnically diverse groups of low\-income youth as well as English learners to support their social and emotional needs during transition.
* At least 1 year of experience supervising a team of three or more staff.
* Experience working with San Francisco's diverse communities and neighborhoods.
* Experience working with community\-based service providers and private sector partners.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Zoom, and other technology platforms.
* Experience facilitating workshops for youth and young adults.
* Ability to work as part of a team, to prioritize and handle multiple tasks and to work independently in a high\-pressure environment.
* Bilingual in Cantonese/Mandarin/Spanish and English is preferred.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Enthusiasm for promoting academic achievement and college education.
* Able to lift or move at least 25lbs
* Ability to work some evenings and weekends.

jobs.title: HEALTH EDUCATION PROGRAM COORDINATOR
jobs.description:
The Health Education Program Coordinator manages and implements health education programs, develops community education and outreach activities, and counsels patients.




**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**




* Develops, implements, coordinates, and evaluates bilingual health education programs and activities on preventative health care, chronic disease management, Western medicine, and other related topics
* Develops curricula, toolkits, health education programs and materials
* Provides group class and/or one\-on\-one health education services to members and the general public
* Acts as primary liaison with appropriate community agencies and schools to establish, promote, and carry out community education and outreach programs
* Manages Health Education centers
* Counsels patients on a variety of subjects such as diabetes, hypertension, asthma, smoking cessation, substance abuse, teen health, Hepatitis B, preventive cancer screening and immunization, etc.
* Coordinates with clinical departments to develop multilingual educational material
* Reviews translations of materials for accuracy and appropriateness
* Researches grants and funding opportunities, and assists in writing grant proposals
* Collects, tabulates, analyzes program data, and prepares reports
* Works collaboratively with Administration and Project Management Department, and provides support in health information projects such as activity schedule, newsletter, informational displays, flyers posters, staff bulletin, community health events, etc.
* Travels to NEMS’ clinic site to conduct programs and events
* Supervises summer interns and volunteers and assists in implementing education activities for the Health Center Week
* Provides day\-to\-day operational support to Health Education Assistants including scheduling, training, and guidance; acts as a liaison to communicate updates or concerns to Health Education Manager as needed
* Supports walk\-ins and provider referrals to Health Education
* Administers Remote Patient Monitoring assignment, monitoring, tracking and calls
* Calls outreach lists tied to organizational goals and PIP measures, as needed
* Assists with ad hoc outreach lists (e.g., health plan initiatives or incentive programs that require patient outreach), as needed
* Covers and rotates to other sites as required
* Performs other job duties as required by manager/supervisor




**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree (degree in public health or related field preferred).
* Health \& Wellness Coach Training completed by a NBC\-HWC\-approved program or ability to obtain it within 6 months of first available training date is required
* CHES certification preferred
* Two years’ experience in community health education, health communication or related field preferred
* Prior experience in program planning, design and implementation that incorporates evidence\-based strategies and cultural competency
* Experience with formative research or program evaluation preferred
* Prior experience working with the underserved, immigrant, low\-income and/or Asian communities preferred
* Current documentation of Basic Life Support is required




**LANGUAGE:**




* Must be fluent in English (reading, writing, and speaking)
* Must be fluent in Chinese: Cantonese and/or Mandarin (reading, writing, and speaking)




**STATUS:**




This is an FLSA Non\-exempt position.


This is not an OSHA high\-risk position.

jobs.title: Senior Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Note:If you are a current employee, please apply through the internal career page.**


IOA is on the forefront of revolutionary healthcare models, reshaping the way people can age in place. Our innovative models transform lives, enhance communities, and save healthcare systems millions of dollars. Rather than focusing on archaic outdated design, we strive to consistently question the “status\-quo” and create new and more innovative ways to help aging adults and adults with disabilities maintain their quality of life.


With over 23 programs, we offer multiple ways to aid seniors maintain their health, well\-being, independence and participation in the community, fulfilling our mission.


Urgently hiring.
  

Serving as the key administrative support team member to the Enrichment Center and supporting other Companioa Programs, this role requires a highly organized and proactive individual to ensure maximum efficiency and streamline operations in a highly dynamic team. Primary duties include supporting client referral to enrollment process, client records compliance, transportation management, supply management, and program coordination.**Prospects, Tours \& Enrollments**

* Maintain a thorough knowledge of all dementia services to communicate Companioa programs effectively and accurately to referral sources, prospects, and other visitors to the Enrichment Center.
* Receive all incoming calls to main line at the Enrichment Center \& provide response within 1 business day.
* Facilitate tours of the Enrichment Center for prospects and referral sources as needed and conduct timely follow up after tour to identify next steps.
* Proactively engage Director as enrollment barriers arise.
* Assist new client / family with Enrichment Center enrollment paperwork.
* Ensure all new clients have a successful transition to designated Companioa programs.
* Assist in completing \& submitting transit applications and supplemental documentation for all impacted new enrollees.
**Client Records \& Billing Management**

* Maintain daily attendance log with updates, notes, and client\-specific needs.
* Enter client status updates (enrollment, disenrollment, hold, etc.) and notes for all communication with prospects and clients into electronic health record within 2 business days.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records for all funder \& grant contracts using required systems.
* Completely and accurately follow client file checklists to ensure files are complete, current, and in compliance with licensing.
* Manage client roster for Enrichment Center and Care Coaching programs. This includes, providing enrollment and disenrollment information in the client health record and submitting accurate attendance reports to billing department.
* Maintain emergency rosters for all enrolled clients with a minimum of monthly updates.
* Collaborate with program liaisons at Veterans Administration, SF Department of Disability and Aging Services, and other grant/funders as needed.
**Transportation**

* Manage relationship and requests with outside transit providers, this includes assisting clients with Paratransit enrollment and coordinating requests for Group Van services, including participation in stakeholder meetings.
* Maintain transportation manifests for multiple providers.
* Document unmet and untimely service in internal logs \& communicate with vendors in real time.
**Supply \& Vendor Management**

* Coordinate meal service with outside vendor to ensure accurate count of meals based on forecasted Enrichment Center attendance.
* Maintain adequate stock of program materials and supply and replenish proactively.
**Other Duties**

* Participate in daily team meetings to inform Enrichment Center staff of the anticipated daily attendance and other details regarding prospects and other visitors.
* Assist Program Director in audit readiness and ongoing monitoring tasks to ensure compliance with state licensing regulations and other service contracts.
* Maintain knowledge of all safety and emergency protocols to effectively direct staff, clients, and visitors.
* Support Enrichment Center programs, including meals and activities, as needed.
* Actively participate in Companioa and IOA meetings.
* Other duties as assigned.
**EDUCATION:**


Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

**BACKGROUND AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Five years of program or administrative experience
* Interest and ability to support older adults, particularly persons with dementia
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines
* Ability to maintain effective relationships with a wide range of internal and external clients
* Team player
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Computer proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook
**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Ability to lift 35 lbs
* Ability to reach, bend and walk
**COMPENSATION:**

**Range:** $ 34 \- 35\.50/hourly

*This amount is not necessarily reflective of actual compensation that may be earned, nor a promise of any specific pay for any specific employee, which is always dependent on actual experience, education and other factors.*

*This range does not include any additional equity, benefits, or other non\-monetary compensation which may be included.*

jobs.title: Client Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Nowadays**
==================


We're building the future of in\-person connection, from intimate exec offsites to a conference\-level company offsite.


Nowadays is the first AI\-powered platform for planning corporate events. Our software handles everything from venue sourcing to vendor negotiations, making it easier and faster for teams to meet up in real life.


We've planned events across the globe for companies like Google, Airbnb, and Quantstamp, and we're just getting started.


Our mission is simple: make it easier for teams to create meaningful moments together.

**Who we are**
==============


We're a sister\-founded team based in San Francisco. We move fast, care deeply, and love bringing people together (whether it's a strategic offsite or a Friendsgiving in our Nowadays home).


We believe the best teams:

* Take ownership
* Keep things scrappy
* Celebrate wins (big and small)
* Genuinely enjoy working (\+ hanging out) together


Some of our favorite team excursions so far:

* Flying trapeze
* Steak\-offs at home
* Hauling a Christmas tree up to the office
* Hitting the spa after a big launch
* Racing an Ironman Relay

**What this role is**
=====================


This is a **zero\-to\-one operations role**. You'll take messy, fast\-moving workflows and turn them into systems that are simple, teachable, and scalable, without losing the human care that defines Nowadays.

**What you'll do**
==================

**80% of your time will focus on event operations and client communication**

* Own events end\-to\-end simultaneously, including clear written \+ verbal on\-brand client communication
* Own and evolve the end\-to\-end ops flow for running events, from first request to post\-event wrap
* Be the point person for prioritizing urgent vs non\-urgent ops issues
* Turn tribal knowledge into clear documentation, onboarding, and templates that anyone can use

**The remaining 20% of your time will focus on building for scale**

* Build scalable playbooks for: running a single complex event start\-to\-finish, and managing many events in parallel
* Partner closely with engineering to: translate customer feedback and bugs into clear product requirements and actionable tickets, and help test, validate, and refine tools before launch
* Create and maintain internal resources: ops onboarding docs, and client\-facing guides and templates for planning offsites
* Continuously identify what should be simplified, automated, or eliminated

**What we're looking for**
==========================

* You consistently put clients first, understanding that this can sometimes require late nights or weekend work
* You can juggle multiple workstreams and know how to prioritize quickly
* You're excellent at turning complexity into clarity
* You care deeply about process, but never at the expense of momentum
* Extreme attention to detail
* You're comfortable working across ops, product, dev, sales, and clients
* You communicate clearly, thoughtfully, and with good judgment
* You like building systems that other people can run
* You want to shape how a company operates, not just follow a playbook

**Bonus points**
================

* Startup zero\-to\-one experience
* Experience working with clients \+ owning client relationships
* Strong intuition for customer experience and boundaries
* Experience writing clear tickets in tools like Linear or Jira
* Comfort with basic SQL or data analysis to answer operational questions
* Comfort using AI/tools to replace manual, repetitive work

**Other details**
=================

**Location**

* In\-person in San Francisco

**Perks**

* Free lunch \+ dinner
* Quarterly team offsites (yes, we went to the White Lotus S3 hotel in Thailand), and exclusive access to top venues and events
* Monthly fitness stipend
* Health insurance
* 12 weeks paid parental leave
* Generous PTO with required time off to recharge
* High ownership, autonomy, and direct access to founders
* Access to top venues, events, and travel experiences

  

Compensation Range: $90K \- $130K

jobs.title: IT Service Desk & SLA Operations Manager
jobs.description:
The IT Service Desk \& SLA Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing the end\-to\-end lifecycle of all IT support tickets, from initial intake through resolution and closure. This role demands unrelenting ownership: you will follow every ticket on its entire journey to the end\-of\-the\-earth to achieve resolution in a timely and effective manner.



Driven by a "Simple Sets You Free" mindset, this role actively strips away bureaucratic friction, eliminates operational waste, and continuously optimizes IT service management processes to maximize efficiency, speed up ticket resolution, and boost customer satisfaction.



### **In This Role, You Will...**


End\-to\-End Ticket Ownership \& Lifecycle Management
* Relentless Resolution Ownership: Personally track and follow tickets on their entire journey to the end\-of\-the\-earth, taking total responsibility until issues are thoroughly, accurately, and effectively resolved.

Queue Administration \& Triage: Monitor, triage, and assign incoming incidents, service requests, and problem tickets across multi\-tiered support teams with speed and accuracy.* Closure \& Quality Control: Validate that all tickets are properly documented, root causes are identified, and end\-users confirm resolution before ticket closure.
* Escalation Management: Identify aging, stuck, or high\-priority (P1/P2\) tickets and proactively cross organizational boundaries to drive action and prevent SLA breaches.


Process Optimization \& Friction Elimination ("Simple Sets You Free")
* Bottleneck Identification: Continuously audit ticket lifecycles, intake workflows, and escalation paths to pinpoint bottlenecks, redundant approvals, or process inefficiencies that delay issue reporting and resolution.
* Streamlined Workflows: Design and implement intuitive, simplified ticketing processes and self\-service channels that make it effortless for users to report issues and for technicians to resolve them.
* Root\-Cause Process Fixing: Collaborate across IT and business departments to re\-engineer flawed processes, remove unnecessary handoffs, and eliminate administrative bloat slowing down resolution times.
* Automation \& Lean Operations: Champion lean service desk practices by eliminating obsolete procedures, automating routine tasks, and establishing straightforward, zero\-friction standards across all support tiers.


SLA \& Metric Tracking
* SLA Monitoring: Enforce and monitor compliance against core SLAs (First Response Time, Mean Time to Resolution \[MTTR], First Contact Resolution \[FCR], and Customer Satisfaction \[CSAT]).
* Reporting \& Dashboards: Design, build, and maintain real\-time operational dashboards and weekly/monthly executive report packs using ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Zendesk).
* Trend Analysis: Analyze incident data to detect recurring technical issues, capacity bottlenecks, or process failures, feeding insights directly into Problem Management.


Process Governance \& Continuous Improvement
* ITIL \& Lean Governance: Standardize and enforce streamlined incident management processes, simplified escalation pathways, and consistent ticket categorization/tagging.
* Vendor \& Cross\-Team Coordination: Hold internal technical teams and external IT vendors accountable to contractual response and resolution targets while streamlining joint operational workflows.
* Customer Feedback: Manage the CSAT survey process, follow up on negative feedback, and implement actionable improvement plans based on direct user input.


### **Qualifications**

* 3–5\+ years in IT Service Management (ITSM), IT Operations, or Service Desk leadership roles with demonstrated experience in end\-to\-end ticket management and lean process optimization.
* Unwavering ownership mentality—willing to follow a ticket to the end\-of\-the\-earth to see it resolved.
* Strong lean operational mindset focused on process simplification and waste reduction.
* Advanced proficiency in ITSM platforms (ServiceNow, Jira Service Desk, BMC Helix, Freshservice, etc.).
* Deep expertise in analytics/BI platforms (Power BI, Tableau, Excel/Google Sheets advanced reporting).

### **Bonus Qualifications**

* ITIL v3/v4 Foundation certification
* Excellent written/verbal communication
* Strong analytical problem\-solving
* Proven ability to simplify complex technical workflows under tight SLA timelines

**Base Salary Range**

There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. A sign\-on bonus may be offered as part of the compensation package. The listed range applies only to the base salary. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level. Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position.

Zoox also offers a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off (e.g. sick leave, vacation, bereavement), unpaid time off, Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights, Amazon RSUs, health insurance, long\-term care insurance, long\-term and short\-term disability insurance, and life insurance.
**About Zoox**
Zoox is developing the first ground\-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility\-as\-a\-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast\-moving and highly execution\-oriented team.

Given ID.me's consumption\-based pricing model, deals often involve non\-standard structures — usage tiers, ramp schedules, minimum commitments — that require careful review and consistent governance. This role is a strong fit for someone who's detail\-oriented, systems\-fluent, and energized by being the person who keeps sales moving efficiently without sacrificing deal quality or compliance.  

Level (Senior Analyst vs. Manager) will be determined based on the candidate's experience.


**Why This Role Matters**



Sales Operations \& Deal Desk is where strategy meets execution — every deal that closes efficiently and every clean pipeline report starts here. This role gives you direct, visible impact on how quickly and effectively ID.me's sales team can operate.


**What You'll Do**



Deal Desk


* Review and approve deal structures, pricing exceptions, discounting, and non\-standard contract terms in line with company policy
* Partner with Sales, Legal, and Finance to structure deals for ID.me's consumption\-based pricing model — usage tiers, minimum commitments, ramp schedules, and renewal terms
* Maintain deal desk approval workflows and playbooks, ensuring consistent turnaround times and clear escalation paths
* Track and report on deal desk cycle time, exception volume, and win/loss patterns tied to deal structure


Sales Operations


* Own CRM data integrity and administration (Salesforce): pipeline hygiene, opportunity stages, fields, and reporting structure
* Support territory design, account assignment, and quota allocation in partnership with Sales leadership
* Build and maintain sales dashboards and reporting for pipeline coverage, forecast accuracy, and rep productivity
* Identify and implement process improvements across the quote\-to\-cash lifecycle, reducing friction for reps and improving data quality for Finance


Cross\-Functional Partnership


* Act as the go\-to resource for sales reps and managers on process, systems, and deal questions
* Partner with Finance/FP\&A to ensure deal terms and CRM data flow cleanly into revenue reporting and forecasting
* Support onboarding and training for new sales hires on CRM usage, deal desk process, and sales tools
* Assist with ad hoc analysis and projects as Revenue Operations scales


**What You'll Bring**


* 3\+ years (Senior Analyst) or 5\+ years (Manager) of experience in sales operations, deal desk, or a related analytical function, ideally in B2B SaaS
* Strong hands\-on experience with Salesforce (or comparable CRM) — administration, reporting, and workflow configuration
* Strong Excel/spreadsheet skills; comfort building clean, reliable analysis under time pressure
* High attention to detail and a process\-oriented mindset — comfortable being the person who enforces consistency
* Clear communicator who can explain policy and process to sales reps without being a bottleneck
* Comfort operating in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment where process is still being built


**Nice to Have**


* Experience with deal structuring for consumption/usage\-based pricing models \- Experience with CPQ tools or quote\-to\-cash process design
* Exposure to sales compensation, territory planning, or forecasting

jobs.title: Sr. Project Manager - Digital PMO
jobs.description:
* San Francisco, CA, United States
* Not Remote
* Engineering
* JOB218093


  
### **Company Description**


It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.


We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.


The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.


If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.


### **Job Description**


**Primary Function of Position:**


Intuitive’s Digital organization aims to improve patient care and empower care teams with unique data and insights from our integrated digital ecosystem. Program Managers in Digital are responsible for delivering new products and sustaining existing capabilities to our customers and partners.


Program Managers in Digital are responsible for delivering new products. We’re looking for people with proven track records of delivering complex, integrated, cross\-functional products with high standards of quality. Digital program managers are engaged in all aspects of the product lifecycle from requirements analysis and architectural design to software engineering development, QA, deployment, and market rollout. Our program managers align hardware and software engineering, clinical and regulatory schedules, and ensure that the right products are created at the right time, with low drama.


At Intuitive, Program Management is not a task\-based job. We are responsible for successful outcomes and delivery. This means that while strong program management fundamentals are a must, the role requires an understanding of product development and manufacturing, and, most importantly, managing through influence.


We look for candidates who know what success looks like and feel a personal stake in the services they support and the people they manage. People who understand how medical technology products are developed. People with a deep well of positive energy and unbounded enthusiasm. We look for people who hold themselves and their program teams to (almost, but not quite) impossibly high standards. People with unshakeable integrity and deep wisdom \& judgment. People who need to know why. People who are comfortable in ambiguity and excel at bringing order to it. People who strive to simplify and to clarify. People who are as comfortable presenting to execs as they are with their nose buried in a burndown chart.


**Roles and Responsibilities:**


* Effectively manage cross\-functional development programs across Intuitive’s different Business units and shared services, overseeing critical projects, and delivering against commitments.
* Help teams prioritize tasks to focus on the critical activities that drive progress and avoid being sidetracked by less important issues.
* Collaborate with the cross\-functional teams to ensure the right people are updated with the right information at the right time on status and ensure that cross\-product dependencies are understood, planned for, and crisply executed
* Perform risk analysis, develop contingency plans, and gather data from functions to proactively raise prioritization and scheduling tradeoff decisions
* Drive required discipline and rigor in requirements analysis, design, development, and testing through good development practices and effective use of phase gates.
* Work across the organization and external partners as needed to align functional support and input for the project
* Contribute to and help lead improvement Intuitive project management processes and ongoing improvements to the way we ship new products and capabilities.
* Function as a primary point\-of\-contact for stakeholders across the org.

### **Qualifications**


**Required Skills and Experience**


* Demonstrated history of leadership in project, program, and portfolio management of software delivery programs, at scale.
* Demonstrated excellence in program management capabilities across product lifecycle, from ideation through commercialization.
* Strong grasp of software product development engineering principles, manufacturing, servicing, and quality control.
* Understanding of Design Controls under US and International Regulations
* Proven ability to think strategically, plan and align product development with business goals and market needs.
* Naturally accountable and responsible; self\-starter, self\-motivated, self\-directed, self\-sufficient.
* Outstanding communication and presentation skills, written and verbal, to all levels of an organization.
* Experience with development and commercialization of medical technology.
* Ability to recognize project challenges and drive creative and simple solutions with a customer\-focused approach
* Proven ability to influence at various levels and drive conflict resolution with low drama

**Required Education and Training**


* At least 8 years of program \& project management experience with a bachelor’s degree and 6 years with a Master’s degree. This must include hands\-on experience with development and commercialization of highly technical medical devices.
* Understanding of Design Controls under US and International Regulations preferred.
* Certification in project management (PMP, CSM) desired

We are an AA/EEO/Veterans/Disabled employer.

**Why CCI?**CCI Systems, Inc. is an Employee\-Owned Telecommunications Company based in Iron Mountain, MI with 60\+ years of industry knowledge and experience. Our outstanding team\-based work culture and environment has allowed us to grow, develop, and retain long\-term employees. We offer a comprehensive benefits package, competitive pay, flexibility, paid on the job training, professional development, and inspire you to be bold, yet accountable. We value our employee’s hard work and determination and **REWARD** results all while having fun! **Our mission** is to make life better by connecting people through innovative communication systems.

**We are seeking** **Permitting****Project Managers** to oversee all activity with regards to his or her projects including, but not limited to, supervision of employees, project staffing, customer needs, workflow, service level agreements (SLA) adherence, financial performance, timely invoice approval, quality control, and all other aspects of work related to his or her projects. This role is customer facing requiring clear communications skills, both verbal and written, as well as polished and professional personal interactions.

**Responsibilities**

* Liaison between cities and jurisdictions, and build meaningful, long\-term relationships in various markets.
* Guide teams and participate with research and prepare documentation for required permits, right of ways, easements, and land use for telecom projects.
* Create and maintain reports, while tracking progress of multiple projects – for complying with conditions of approvals from municipalities for meeting customer delivery deadlines.
* Obtain all necessary permitting / zoning approval from Federal, State, and local agencies \- Inform other internal functional groups about requirements and regulations of government entities and municipalities to assist with compliance with general conditions of approvals at permit and construction stages of the project, and to meet project timelines.
* Oversees the preparation and submission of permit packages for permit applications adhering to strict standards and regulations.
* Monitor staffing needs in the project group along with maintaining staffing projections.
* Ensure that a Scope of Work is in place for all their projects.
* Create and adhere to revenue, gross profit, accounts receivable, and staffing forecasts.
* Act as the liaison between customers and the internal operations of the project group. This is to ensure that customer’s expectations are met and maintain goodwill for future business.
* Execute project implementation/startup and continuous production management.
* Monitor projects to improve the quality of the work and to reduce the time and cost of project throughput.
* Create and promote the company image through exercising sound and ethical business practices as related to employees, the public and customers. This includes ensuring that service and quality provided to customers is superior to that of our competition.
* Meet regularly with key personnel to ensure that information flows in both directions and to ensure that stated goals and objectives are met.
* Implement corrective actions, as appropriate, on any project to meet cost targets, and completion schedules.
* Ensures subordinates’ abilities are adequate for their responsibilities and develops training and cross training for ongoing skill development.
* Assist personnel with interpreting customer drawings, project documentation, and technical specifications.
* Conducts performance reviews for all direct reports. Does follow up on reviews with substandard grading. Create an environment in which the rating of an average employee is continually challenged. Create goals for employee during review and have mid\-year follow up on said goals.
* Complete invoicing within Service Level Agreements including follow up on unpaid invoices. Make sure purchase orders are in place prior to work startup.
* Perform other related duties as assigned by their supervisor.

 **Qualifications**

* 5\+ years’ experience in permitting design, government affairs or related work in a Utility / Permitting environment in a related industry preferred.
* 5\+ years of Project Management experience in utility permitting or related field preferred.
* In\-depth understanding of NESC 202X code requirements preferred.
* Regulatory Compliance Expertise: Advanced understanding of local, state, and federal regulations related to underground utilities, coupled with the ability to effectively incorporate these regulations into permit drawings,
* Advanced understanding of Telecom OSP Engineering and Construction standards to apply design standards to underground and aerial pole line cable plant, including Joint Use Design, Pole Replacement, Primary Service, and Reliability/Maintenance Design.
* Proven leadership of a Make Ready Team to Perform structural loading calculations using O\-Calc or Spida\-Calc in accordance with NESC and pole owner protocol through inventory and analysis of pole type and class, riser details, attached facility type including weight and diameters, span footages, drip loops etc.
* Ability to create 3\-dimensional model of poles in O\-Calc and Spida\-Calc to provide results to ensure safe and proper attachment to power and telecommunication poles.
* Analytical and observational skills, which demonstrate ability to, plan projects, review/recommend technical specifications, coordinate staffing needs, communicate, and manage all aspects of a project.
* Proven ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high\-pressure environment is crucial.
* Effectively work independently and in a team\-oriented, collaborative environment is essential.
* Proven ability to solve problems creatively.
* Persuasive, encouraging and motivating with the ability to elicit cooperation from a wide variety of sources, including upper management, clients, and other departments.

jobs.description:
**Company Description** **Specific information regarding this recruitment process is listed below.**

**Application Opening:** Wednesday, September 9, 2026  

**Application Deadline:** Apply immediately. Application filing will be open at least through 11:59pm (PST) of Wednesday, September 16, 2026, and will close any time thereafter.  

**Salary Range:** $228,124 \- $245,570 Annually ($109\.67 \- $118\.06 hourly)  

**Recruitment ID:** PEX\-5504\-164763; RTF0164762\-01121906

**Appointment Type:** Permanent\-Exempt (PEX), Category 18\. This position is excluded by the Charter from the competitive Civil Service examination process and shall serve at the discretion of the Appointing Officer and shall not exceed 36 months


Becoming a City employee means being a part of a team that cares about making a difference. Your work will shape both the present and future of San Francisco. When you work for the City, you’re choosing a job with purpose.


San Francisco Public Works (Public Works) has a far\-reaching portfolio with a $453 million annual operating budget, an active capital portfolio that exceeds $3 billion and a workforce of 1,700\-plus employees. The department operates around the clock, touching every neighborhood in San Francisco. The staff designs and manages the construction of civic buildings and streets; cleans and greens the right of way; maintains civic buildings; manages multi\-million\-dollar bond programs; trains people for jobs; keeps the right of way free of hazards; paves the roads; repairs bridges and public stairways; expands accessibility; and works at the forefront addressing some of San Francisco’s biggest challenges. With a mission to enhance the quality of life in San Francisco for residents, visitors and business owners, Public Works is committed to providing outstanding public service through an equity lens.


Please visit the “About Us” section of our website at https://www.sfpublicworks.org to learn more about the department’s core values, Racial Equity Initiative, leadership team, history, budget and more.


Public Works currently has 2 vacancies for a Project Manager II (5504\) within the Project Delivery Division.

 **Job Description** **Role Description:**


The San Francisco Public Works streetscape portfolio encompasses a number of major projects including the Bayview Multimodal Improvement Projects, the 11th Street Safety Project and other projects totaling over $121 million, with active planning, design, construction, or financial closeout phases extending through 2030\. These projects involve transforming high\-volume corridors through multi\-modal safety enhancements, protected bike lanes, and extensive utility and public realm upgrades while coordinating closely with merchants and local community benefit districts to mitigate event impacts. These projects involve working with design elements that involve deep partnership with community leaders and cultural stakeholders. Together, these citywide efforts backed by interagency collaboration with partners such as the SFMTA, San Francisco Planning, and the SFPUC aim to modernize San Francisco's corridors, elevate pedestrian safety, and celebrate neighborhood identity.

**Important and Essential Duties include, but are not limited to:**

* Directing and overseeing a portfolio of major streetscape, transit, and public realm capital projects through active phases of planning, design, construction, and financial closeout.
* Providing technical oversight, performance guidance, and mentorship to subordinate project managers overseeing portfolios valued at up to $66 million.
* Coordinating the implementation of large\-scale multi\-modal safety enhancements, roadway reconstructions, utility and sewer upgrades, traffic signals, green infrastructure, and public realm improvements.
* Engaging with neighborhood organizations, stakeholders, and business districts to preserve historical character\-defining features and address community concerns during project execution.
* Coordinating complex construction sequencing around major public venues, commercial activities, and high\-traffic events to minimize disruption to the community.
* Leading interagency and cross\-departmental collaboration by partnering with municipal planning, transportation, utilities, arts, and recreation agencies to secure approvals, align public realm plans, and ensure cohesive design standards across the city.

  

**Qualifications** **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**


1\. a) Bachelor's Degree in architecture, engineering or planning; **and**  

 b) Four (4\) years of responsible professional experience in architectural, engineering or construction management experience; **and**  

 c) Two (2\) years of additional project coordination experience;

**OR**


2\. a) Bachelor's Degree in another field; **and**  

 b) Six (6\) years of responsible professional experience in a field directly related to the project; **and**  

 c) Two (2\) years of additional project coordination experience;  

  

**OR**


3\. a) Eight (8\) years of architectural, engineering, or construction management experience in a field directly related to the project; **and**  

 b) Two (2\) years of additional project coordination experience;  

  

**OR**


4\. a) California registration as professional engineer or architect; **and**  

 b) Two (2\) years of additional project coordination experience

**Note:**

jobs.title: IT Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Pivot Point Solutions**
=========================



Pivot Point Solutions is a California\-based technology consulting firm that specializes in delivering IT solutions and support for the construction and utility industries. We partner with organizations across the state to provide reliable technology services that improve operational efficiency, enhance project delivery, and support critical business systems.



Our team understands the unique technology challenges facing construction and utility organizations, from field operations and infrastructure projects to enterprise applications and cybersecurity. By combining industry expertise with responsive service, we help clients modernize their technology environments, streamline workflows, and maintain secure, reliable IT systems that support long\-term growth.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**Title:** Senior IT Project Manager  

**Sector:** Information Technology / Utilities  

**Seniority:** Senior Level  

**Location:** Oakland, CA – Local Candidates Only  

**Job Type:** Hybrid / Primarily Remote with Occasional Office Attendance  

**Contract Length:** 1 Year \+  

**Compensation:** $62\.87 \- $83\.33/hour


**Role Overview**
-----------------



Pivot Point Solutions is seeking an experienced Senior IT Project Manager to lead complex, high\-visibility Meter\-to\-Cash technology initiatives within a large utility environment. This position will have end\-to\-end responsibility for multi\-year projects involving significant budgets, organizational dependencies, regulatory considerations, and coordination across business, technology, engineering, vendors, and senior leadership.



The ideal candidate is an established senior Project Manager who has successfully delivered large enterprise IT initiatives and can independently manage scope, schedule, budget, risk, governance, stakeholder alignment, and executive communication. Experience leading $15M–$20M technology projects and initiatives tied to regulatory commitments is highly desirable.


**Your Day\-to\-Day Activities**
--------------------------------


* Provide end\-to\-end leadership for complex, multi\-year Meter\-to\-Cash IT projects.
* Serve as the primary point of accountability for assigned projects from initiation through implementation and closeout.
* Define project objectives, scope, delivery strategies, milestones, dependencies, and success criteria.
* Evaluate project feasibility and ensure objectives, schedules, budgets, and delivery expectations are achievable.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans, governance structures, risk management strategies, and executive reporting.
* Manage project budgets, forecasts, schedules, scope, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, and change.
* Coordinate across IT, business, engineering, operations, vendors, consultants, and other supporting organizations.
* Partner with technical and engineering teams on complex alternatives, risk analyses, studies, and solution recommendations.
* Identify significant project risks early and drive mitigation and contingency planning.
* Manage conflicts and competing priorities across project teams and stakeholder organizations.
* Support projects involving regulatory commitments, compliance requirements, or other high\-visibility business obligations.
* Prepare and deliver project updates, recommendations, and decision materials to senior executives and leadership.
* Manage external partners and formal project relationships where applicable.
* Establish and promote project management best practices across teams and programs.
* Mentor and provide guidance to less experienced Project Managers.
* Maintain project documentation and governance deliverables in accordance with enterprise PMO standards.

**The Job Requirements**
------------------------


* Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
* 8\+ years of progressive experience in project management, project controls, engineering, construction, or closely related project delivery disciplines.
* PMP certification in active standing.
* Significant experience independently managing complex enterprise IT projects.
* Experience leading projects across the full lifecycle from planning and initiation through implementation and closeout.
* Demonstrated responsibility for project scope, schedule, budget, risk, issues, dependencies, resources, and stakeholder management.
* Experience coordinating across multiple business and technical organizations.
* Strong executive communication skills with experience presenting project status, risks, recommendations, and decisions to senior leadership.
* Demonstrated ability to resolve conflicts and drive decisions across complex project teams.
* Strong risk management and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Ability to work independently with limited direction in a high\-visibility environment.
* Must be local and available to commute to the office occasionally based on project and team needs.

**You'll Stand Out If You Have**
--------------------------------


* Direct experience leading Meter\-to\-Cash technology initiatives within an electric or gas utility.
* Experience with utility metering, billing, customer information, revenue, or related enterprise systems.
* Experience managing individual IT projects or programs valued at approximately $15M–$20M.
* Experience delivering technology initiatives tied to regulatory commitments or compliance deadlines.
* Experience working within a mature enterprise IT PMO environment.
* Experience managing multi\-year initiatives involving multiple vendors, business units, and technology teams.
* Experience presenting directly to executive or officer\-level leadership.
* Previous experience mentoring or providing delivery guidance to other Project Managers.

**About Pivot Point Solutions**
-------------------------------

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager
jobs.description:
Whether you're a recent grad or a seasoned professional, you can experience meaningful career growth at Rosendin. Enjoy a true sense of ownership as you work with a proven industry leader on some of the most exciting and high\-profile projects in the nation. We offer a wide range of job opportunities, competitive compensation, full benefits, an Employee Stock Ownership Plan and more.


**Why Rosendin?**


**Committed. Innovative. Engaged.**


If you're looking to take career to the next level and work with some of the best and brightest in the industry, we want to hear from you. We are an organization built on integrity. We have a culture that empowers people, embraces diversity, and inspires everyone to do their best. Rosendin is one of the largest electrical contractors in the United States employing over 7,000 people. We are the largest **EMPLOYEE\-OWNED** company in the industry which means you will be a company owner too and have the unique benefit of being a shareholder at a company that is experiencing tremendous growth and success which means you benefit tremendously.


**YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY:**
--------------------------


The Assistant Project Manager is an entry\-level project management position and is expected to learn and develop competency in the Essential Duties and Responsibilities. In addition, the APM is responsible for providing administrative and construction support for our Project Management team.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**
-------------------

* Manage project documentation, including submittals, RFIs, (Return for Information), and meeting minutes.
* Oversee project activities as assigned by the Project Manager, including planning, coordinating, circumventing/resolving problem areas, ensuring all company/project policies, procedures, and standards are maintained, etc.
* Maintain change orders, submittal, and document (drawing) control logs. Prepare required logs and other project documentation for construction meetings.
* Responsible for contract submittals that are accurate and timely.
* Responsible for creating and issuing the Subcontractors' contracts.
* Responsible for the assembly and timely delivery of the Owner and Maintenance Manuals.
* Ensure that the project quality control plan is followed.
* Interacts with subcontractors to ensure we have obtained the correct documentation and drawing for the Owner and Maintenance Manuals.
* Responsible for keeping the Warranty Log up to date.
* Attend company/project meetings with clients, subcontractors, etc., and provide project management support
* Cooperate with and technically assist field personnel assigned to the area of responsibility.
* Monitor other contractors' activities and progress.
* Responsible for creating the Job Information Sheets and establishing Job Files.
* Prepares price change orders and project reports and documentation.
* Works with payroll to ensure accurate payroll information.
* The duties and responsibilities describe this position's general nature and scope of work. This is a partial listing, and other responsibilities will be assigned based on the position's role within the business unit.


**WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL:**
--------------------------------------

* Knowledge of construction technology, scheduling, equipment, and methods required
* Tactful and has a professional demeanor, and ability to interact effectively with managers, employees, vendors, and others
* Strong organizational, record\-keeping, and follow\-up skills
* Strong attention to details
* Demonstrated excellence in organization and time management skills
* Identify and meet customers' expectations and requirements
* Proficient in using a computer and Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, etc.); Oracle preferred
* Prioritize and manage multiple tasks, changing priorities as necessary
* Work under pressure and adapt to changing requirements with a positive attitude
* Oral and written communication skills as required for the position
* Self\-motivated, proactive, and an effective team player
* Interact effectively and professionally with all levels of employees, both management and staff alike, vendors, clients, and others


**WHAT YOU BRING TO US:**
-------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management or related field
* Minimum 1 year of experience in a construction\-related role
* Can be a combination of training, education, and relevant work experience that is equivalent


**TRAVEL:**
-----------

* Up to 25%


**WORKING CONDITIONS:**
-----------------------

* General work environment \- This position is performed primarily on active construction sites. Activity includes sitting for extended periods, standing, walking, typing, carrying, pushing, bending. Work is conducted primarily indoors with varying environmental conditions, such as fluorescent lighting and air conditioning.
* Noise level is typically low to medium.
* Occasional lifting of up to 30 lbs.
* We fully comply with the ADA and applicable state law, including considering reasonable accommodation measures that may enable qualified disabled applicants and employees to perform essential functions.


Rosendin Electric is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are considered regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, age (over 40\), or any other categories protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.


**YOU Matter \- Our Benefits**

* ESOP \- Employee Stock Ownership
* 401k
* Annual bonus program based upon performance, profitability, and achievement
* 17 PTO days per year plus 10 paid holidays
* Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance
* Term Life, AD\&D Insurance, and Voluntary Life Insurance
* Disability Income Protection Insurance
* Pre\-tax Flexible Spending Plans (Health and Dependent Care)
* Charitable Giving Match with our Rosendin Foundation

**Pay Range

jobs.title: Program Manager, Consumption Products
jobs.description:
**WHAT IS BOX?**



Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI\-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.



By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It's the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.


**WHY BOX NEEDS YOU**



Box is expanding into a new era of monetization, one that blends our trusted subscription model with dynamic, consumption\-based pricing for AI\-powered and Platform capabilities. As the Program Manager, Consumption Products, you will own the day\-to\-day operations of this early\-stage but high\-priority business, sitting at the intersection of product, finance, analytics, and our customer\-facing teams. This is a rare opportunity to build something new at scale: you will help define how Box monetizes AI Units today and lay the operational foundation for expanding consumption\-based models across our Platform and beyond.



This role reports to the VP, Renewals and Consumption and carries direct visibility with Box's Chief Operating Officer and other senior leaders. You will work across an exceptionally diverse set of teams \- from Product Management and Data Engineering to Billing, Marketing, and Account Teams serving as the connective tissue that keeps this fast\-moving program running accurately and efficiently.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**



You will own the customer\-facing consumption program at Box globally. As the owner, you will:


* Monitor daily customer consumption, overage trends, and program activity, identifying accounts that require action and driving unresolved issues to closure.
* Coordinate and execute operational actions including exception handling, managing customer controls, advising on account\-specific treatments, and providing validated data for periodic customer reporting and billing.
* Serve as the first\-line subject matter expert for consumption billing questions from Account Teams and GTM stakeholders, providing timely guidance on program mechanics, alerts, and commercial considerations.
* Work with Business Analytics and Product teams to investigate new usage patterns and new reporting capabilities, translating business requirements into clear, actionable requests for analysts and data specialists.
* Review product updates and policy changes to assess operational impact, and contribute to internal playbooks, FAQs, and customer\-facing guidance.
* Act as the cross\-functional orchestrator across work\-streams converting ambiguous problems into clear decisions, owners, and action plans — while maintaining an integrated view of dependencies across product, billing, analytics, marketing, and customer communications.
* Lead the expansion of consumption billing to new products at Box


**WHO YOU ARE**



You love building from scratch and leaving your mark. You are someone who excitedly brings structure to chaos, with the ability to connect disparate dots and discern signal from noise. You are incredibly detail oriented with a "GSD" mindset, while always keeping the big picture in mind. Where others see problems, you see solutions. You always put the customer in the center of your decision making. If this sounds like you, you also likely have the following experience:


* You have 4\+ years of experience in management consulting, program management, operations, or a cross\-functional business role, ideally within a consulting firm, SaaS or technology company.
* You have a strong understanding of SaaS business models and familiarity with consumption\-based or usage\-based pricing, including AI\-driven products.
* You have clearly demonstrated quantitative analysis experience, comfortably bring able to perform moderate analyses' and interpreting data prepared by others
* You communicate clearly and concisely in both written and verbal form, with the ability to simplify complex policies, workflows, and commercial terms for diverse audiences.
* You have strong attention to detail when handling customer\-specific terms, exceptions, alerts, and operational actions.


Box lives its values, with community and in\-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. Boxers are expected to work from their assigned office a minimum of 3 days per week. Your Recruiter will share more about how we work and company culture during the hiring process.



At Box, we believe unique and diverse experiences benefit our culture, our products, our customers, our company, and our world. We aim to recruit a passionate, high\-performing workforce that reflects the world we live in. If you are head\-over\-heels about this role but unsure if you meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply!


**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY**



We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, and any other protected ground of discrimination under applicable human rights legislation. **Job Description**  

  

The Community Youth Center of San Francisco (CYC) provides the youth of our city a sense of belonging and vital tools and experiences to succeed in life. Our services include academic support and college counseling, job placement and employment training, substance use and violence prevention education, crisis intervention and mediation, leadership development, technology and computer training. Our mission is to encourage a diverse population of high\-need young people to explore their full potential through academic, career, family, and community life.

**Title:****Program Leader**

**Salary:****$23\.50\-$27\.00/Hour**

**Reports to:****Site Coordinator/Beacon Director**

**Status:** **Part****\-Time, Non\-Exempt (school year end: 6/2/2027\)**

**POSITION DESCRIPTION:**


Under the supervision of the Site Coordinator, the Program Leader is responsible for developing, implementing, and overseeing a variety of academic and enrichment activities targeting middle school youth at the CYC Aptos Beacon Center. This includes designing curriculum and activities which incorporate skill building and project based learning that are fun and engaging for youth.


We are looking for multiple staff to teach one or more of the following enrichment activities:

* Arts (i.e. painting, drawing, crafting, etc.)
* Mixed Sports (i.e. soccer, basketball, table tennis, skateboarding, etc.)
* Performing Arts (i.e. drama, voice, dance, etc.)
* Cooking, Gardening, Cultural Arts and Exploration
* Academic Tutoring
* Career \& College Awareness
* STEAM (i.e. coding, 3D printing, game design, robotics, video/music production, etc.)

 **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Develop, implement, and oversee a variety of skill building and project based learning activities for middle school aged youth.
* Provide academic tutoring and assist students with their daily homework as needed.
* Establish and maintain a positive and safe learning environment for program participants including assisting with classroom and behavior management, resolving and mediating conflicts using restorative practices, handling emergencies and injuries, etc.
* Create marketing strategies and promotional materials to recruit and retain youth in afterschool programs.
* Collaborate with school and Beacon staff to coordinate cultural celebrations and culminating events that builds community and celebrates youth accomplishments.
* Work with school faculty and parents/guardians to maintain a high level of communication and positive relationships/climate between school, beacon and families.
* Assist with data collection and produce programmatic reports as requested.
* Assist with administering and collecting evaluation data as required by funders and for continuous program improvement.
* Participate in regular staff meetings and attend on\-going training opportunities as needed.
* Maintain the cleanliness and organization of all shared program spaces.
* Complete other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

 **QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree preferred or must have completed a minimum of 48 college units or passed an Instructional Aide Exam.
* Knowledge of youth development practices and one or more years of experience planning and facilitating enrichment activities for youth.
* Experience in classroom management, conflict mediation, and restorative practices is a plus.
* Experience working with ethnically diverse youth and families who have experienced poverty, crisis, trauma, and other adverse events is a plus.
* Ability to develop, implement, and organize programs and special events.
* Possess good organizational, communication and teamwork skills.
* Capacity to multitask, work independently, and meet strict programmatic deadlines.
* Good technology skills (familiar with Google docs \& sheets, MS Office, etc.)
* Ability to model to staff and participants: professionalism, personal responsibility, a strong work ethic and positive character.
* Bilingual in Cantonese/Mandarin, Spanish, or Tagalog is preferred.
* Able to lift or move at least 25lbs.

jobs.description:
**Company Overview**


Embark on an enriching journey with PROCEPT BioRobotics, where our vision, mission, and values guide everything we do as a company. At PROCEPT, we put the patient first in everything we do and are committed to revolutionizing treatment for benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH, otherwise known as prostate gland enlargement) through innovation in surgical robotics. As our company succeeds and grows, we improve the quality of life of patients, provide more effective treatment options for surgeons, uphold the trust of our shareholders. That starts with a commitment to our People with a focus on creating an evolving landscape for your career, brimming with transformative opportunities that provide continuous career growth opportunities.

**Understanding PROCEPT's Culture**


At PROCEPT, we believe every person matters. Every employee, every patient, every caregiver. Because we are here to create a revolution, and we believe in doing that by innovating everywhere with pathological optimism. We believe in being humble and highly engaged in the work we do, while also working together seamlessly for a common goal. At Procept, curiosity, ingenuity and conviction in the power technology will transform the lives of our patients and providers.




And this doesn’t happen by accident. It starts with our live induction program that serves as an incubator for cross\-functional team building, an immersion in Procept’s history, jam\-packed interactive sessions with executive leadership and a crash\-course in the mission and purpose of what we do. It continues with our one\-of\-a\-kind management program designed to build the best managers in the industry, where our people managers across functions come together to exchange ideas and grow, as both managers and learners, in an environment that challenges, supports and broadens.




We are fueled by the opportunity to give people their lives back. And we believe that it begins with YOU! At Procept, we push beyond just finding a work/life balance, we strive to find a work/life blend, a professional world that you are honored and impassioned to belong to, one that you can proudly share with your family, friends, and acquaintances.




An opportunity at PROCEPT BioRobotics won’t just be about finding a job. It will be an opportunity for you to join a community devoted to making a difference in this world!

 **The Opportunity That Awaits You:**

Do you want to be part of an innovative, cutting\-edge technology and robotics company that is transforming the treatment of BPH? Are you excited to work with an enthusiastic, driven, and collaborative team that continuously learns and improves together? Are you passionate about driving process excellence and making a meaningful impact? Are you detail\-oriented and thrive in a fast\-paced NPI environment?


At PROCEPT BioRobotics, you will contribute to our continuous improvement culture as a member of the Quality Engineering team, supporting New Product Introduction (NPI) activities for disposables and accessories. As a **Senior Quality Assurance Technician**, you will perform inspections, testing, documentation, and other quality\-related activities to help ensure that single\-use products and accessory components meet established requirements from development through commercialization.


This role will support product quality activities with a primary focus on Verification \& Validation (V\&V) testing and New Product Introduction (NPI). This role works cross\-functionally with R\&D, Manufacturing, and Quality Engineering to ensure products meet design requirements, regulatory standards, and company quality objectives throughout the product lifecycle. Success in this position requires strong attention to detail, a hands\-on and proactive approach, effective communication, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced NPI environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with Quality Engineering, R\&D, and Manufacturing during product development and design transfer to support prototype builds, design iterations, engineering studies, pilot builds, and product testing.
* Prepare, label, track, store, and maintain traceability of test samples throughout testing.
* Set up test fixtures, equipment, instrumentation, and samples in accordance with approved procedures and protocols.
* Verify that test and measurement equipment is within calibration before use and report any equipment\-related issues.
* Execute design verification and validation protocols, including functional, reliability, performance, and simulated\-use testing.
* Perform visual, dimensional, and functional inspections using approved methods and inspection equipment.
* Accurately record test conditions, observations, and results in accordance with Good Documentation Practices (GDP).
* Compile and summarize test data for review by Quality Engineering and other project stakeholders. Identify, document, and promptly escalate protocol deviations, nonconformances, equipment issues, and unexpected test results.
* Support failure investigations and root cause analysis by reproducing failures, collecting evidence, performing measurements, and documenting observations.
* Provide practical feedback regarding product testability, manufacturability, inspection methods, and potential quality risks.
* Support the development and improvement of test fixtures, inspection methods, work instructions, and test procedures.
* Assist with document control activities, including drafting, reviewing, and updating procedures, test methods, forms, and associated quality records.
* Support equipment maintenance, laboratory organization, material inventory, and workplace cleanliness. Follow applicable environmental, health, and safety requirements when handling equipment, chemicals, and test samples.
* Perform assigned activities in accordance with the FDA Quality Management System Regulation (QMSR), ISO 13485, EU MDR, and PROCEPT’s internal quality s

jobs.description:
Title: QA Technician  
Full\-Time \| Non\-Exempt \| Hourly

POSITION OVERVIEW  
Location: Emeryville, CA (On\-site)  
Pay Rate: $24 \- $26/hour (Depending on experience)  
Department: Quality  
Reports To: QA Manager

Schedule:

Monday through Friday shifts: 4:00AM \- 12:30PM (Weekend availability a plus!)

OR

Saturday and Sunday shifts

Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), PTO \& Sick Leave

ABOUT PETIT POT  
Petit Pot is a growing food manufacturing company based in Emeryville, CA. We produce high\-quality French\-inspired desserts and are proud to be a Certified B Corporation, balancing purpose and profit while considering the impact of our decisions on our employees, customers, community, and the environment.

POSITION SUMMARY  
The QA Technician is responsible for ensuring that all production paperwork is completed, collected, organized, reviewed, and filed to the satisfaction of all pertinent regulatory agencies and customers. Ensure the site is always audit\-ready by maintaining GMP, Organic, SQF, and any other certifications. Ensure the quality of all incoming ingredients, batches, and finished products. Perform required quality testing of products and records accurate product specifications in a timely manner. The ideal candidate will have a good understanding of food safety protocols, quality control processes, and regulatory compliance in the food manufacturing industry.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  
\- Maintain a solid and up\-to\-date understanding of all regulatory issues pertaining to the completion, review, and filing of production paperwork.  
\- Maintain a solid and up\-to\-date understanding of all customer requirements and preferences pertaining to the completion, review, and filing of production paperwork.  
\- Collect all production paperwork, ensuring that any missing paperwork is located.  
\- Provide aggressive reporting and retraining for all incomplete, incorrect, or non\-compliant paperwork.  
\- Organize paperwork per established filing system.  
\- Review paperwork, ensuring that all process CCP’s, quality specifications, and customer requirements have been met. Any product affected by deviations or missing records must be reported to QA Manager and placed on QA hold.  
\- Manage filing systems such that all completed and reviewed records are maintained and accessible for the time required by customers and regulatory agencies.  
\- Release product.  
\- Provide assistance/support as needed with the customer, government, and third\-party audits.  
\- Ensure all products meet the customer and product requirements.  
\- Always keep all work areas and equipment within SQF standards and clean.  
\- Ensure all personal protective equipment is always properly worn.  
\- Ensure all equipment is set up, calibrated, and functioning properly throughout your shift.  
\- Keep all equipment that is used clean, in your area always, and prepared for the next run.  
\- Perform several checks to the batches such as Color, pH \& sensory, vacuum and % solid.  
\- Obtain batch samples by opening kettles, turning off agitators, ladle the samples, place samples in beakers, and take them to QC Bench for testing.  
\- Obtain liquid ingredient samples from bulk containers and perform testing on them.  
\- Recommend adjustments be made to batches by adding or subtracting ingredients.  
\- Monitor the Filler Machine and lines by checking the weights, charts, codes, labeling, pasteurizer temperatures and perform hourly finished product analysis.  
\- Verify codes and charts very closely \- the ink can run dry and codes can be set wrong.  
\- Perform visual checks and record results, weigh product on calibrated scales, obtain and bring the samples to the QC bench for testing, perform tests, and record results.  
\- Place batches of finished products on hold as required.  
\- Copy batch cards as required for kitchen operators.  
\- All other assigned duties required during your work period.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE  
\- GED or High School Diploma  
\- Previous QA experience in a food manufacturing environment.  
\- Ability to work with numbers, perform calculations, and possess mechanical abilities.  
\- Ability to identify food safety concerns or risks.  
\- Demonstrated ability to work independently, with limited supervision.  
\- Communication skills: must be able to communicate and work closely with all departments and management levels.  
\- Keep up with a fast\-paced work environment and record data as required in a timely manner.  
\- Extreme attention to detail.  
\- Strong organizational ability.  
\- Good communication skills (both written and verbal).  
\- General computer proficiency (Word, Excel, etc.).  
\- Ability to attend and successfully complete related training programs.  
\- Spanish (Plus, not required)

EQUIPMENT AND TOOLS USED  
\- Use the following equipment: Refractometer, Salt Titrator, Acid Titrator, PH Meter, Color Meter, Moisture Meter, Viscometer, and Consistometer, various gages, torque meters and other equipment as required.  
\- Handcarts and pallet jacks.  
\- Forklift (not all QC Techs.)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS  
\- SQF Certified (Plus, not required)  
\- PCQI Certified (Plus, not required)  
\- HACCP Certified (Plus, not required)  
\- Experience in the food manufacturing industry required.  
\- Knowledge of food safety regulations, quality standards, and production best practices.  
\- Experience with lean manufacturing, process improvement, or waste reduction is a plus.  
\- Experience in dessert, dairy, pudding, or refrigerated food production is a plus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT/CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS  
\- Varied temperature work areas.  
\- The environment is very wet, slippery, and has continuous forklift traffic.  
\- Handle and work around various moving equipment and chemicals.  
\- Frequent use of hot/cold water to perform checks and clean equipment and area.  
\- Frequent lifting objects \< 30 lbs. and pushing/pulling of objec
