**ISSA is seeking a Lifecycle Marketing Associate contractor to directly support Health Coach Institute (HCI), part of the ISSA family of brands.** **While this position is posted through ISSA’s career network, your day\-to\-day focus, campaigns, and audience engagement will be dedicated specifically to HCI's programs and student lifecycle.** **This is a fixed\-term contract position scheduled through December 2026\.** **About HCI:** At Health Coach Institute (HCI), we empower purpose\-driven individuals to transform lives through human\-centered, science\-based coaching education. For over a decade, we’ve set the standard in health and life coach certification by blending behavioral psychology, habit\-change methodology, and practical business skills. Whether your goal is to build a thriving private practice or earn top\-tier industry credentials, HCI provides the accredited training, hands\-on practice, and ongoing support you need to make a meaningful, lasting impact.**So What's the Job?**  

As the **Lifecycle Marketing Associate contractor,** you will provide executional support to the Sr. Brand Manager, turning the lifecycle marketing and promo strategy into deployed reality. The Associate builds, QAs, and sends email and SMS campaigns in HubSpot, keeps the lifecycle nurture program updated/running day\-to\-day, and grows into owning audience segmentation over time. This is a hands\-on execution role, not a strategy\-setting one — strategy is set by the Sr. Brand Manager; this role makes it happen on schedule and error\-free.* **Campaign Execution \& QA:** Build, QA, and deploy email and SMS campaigns in HubSpot—including promos, webinar sequences, nurture flows, and one\-off sends—on schedule and error\-free.
* **Testing \& Optimization:** Design and run A/B tests across email/SMS campaigns and audience segmentation to optimize performance.
* **Email Calendar Management:** Build and maintain an organized month\-to\-month email calendar to ensure strategic clarity and operational alignment across the organization.
* **Lifecycle Nurture Execution:** Execute and manage the email/SMS lifecycle nurture framework (0–30, 30–60, 60–90, and 90\+ day segments) as defined by the Sr. Brand Manager.
* **Nurture Program Development:** Build and launch new nurture workflows to support evolving business and marketing needs.
* **List Hygiene \& Segmentation:** Build, maintain, and continuously improve audience segmentation and list hygiene as HubSpot data models and properties evolve.
* **Webinar Comms Management:** Support the six\-email webinar communications sequence (from registration confirmation through replay delivery) end to end.
* **Deployment QA Discipline:** Thoroughly QA every send before deployment, including link verification, personalization tokens, segmentation/list targeting, and deliverability fundamentals.
* **Promo Calendar Support:** Assist with promo calendar execution—including banners, send scheduling, and adherence to payment links and pricing structures.
* **Performance Monitoring \& Reporting:** Track core campaign metrics (open rates, click\-through rates, conversion rates) and flag anomalies or opportunities to the Sr. Brand Manager. Pull and analyze email performance data on a month\-to\-month basis to track overall email health, deliverability, and channel engagement trends
* **Cross\-Functional Alignment:** Partner with the broader marketing and social media teams to ensure campaign timing and messaging remain cohesive across all channels.

**What is ISSA/HCI looking for?*** **Hands\-on HubSpot Expertise:** Experience building and deploying email/SMS campaigns and automated workflows directly in HubSpot (hands\-on execution, not observational experience).
* **Track Record of Execution:** Proven ability to take a brief and deliver a fully built, thoroughly tested, and deployed campaign with minimal supervision.
* **Strong Segmentation Aptitude:** Comfortable working directly with audience lists, custom properties, and behavior\-based segmentation logic.
* **High Attention to Detail \& QA Discipline:** Meticulous approach to quality control—success in this role is judged on error\-free sends, not just on\-time deployments.
* **Exceptional Organizational Skills:** Ability to keep campaigns, timelines, and deliverables structured and on track in a fast\-paced environment.
* **Adaptability:** Comfortable navigating a fast\-moving, evolving marketing calendar with shifting priorities and tight deadlines.
* **Proactive Communication:** Clear, effective communicator who actively flags blockers, risks, and QA issues well in advance of send dates.

**Nice to have:**

* Prior experience specifically with lifecycle/nurture email programs (not just one\-off campaign sends).
* Familiarity with email deliverability fundamentals (sender reputation, list hygiene, spam triggers).
* Experience supporting webinar or live\-event communications sequences.
* Exposure to SMS marketing platforms/compliance basics (opt\-in/opt\-out handling).

**Success in this role looks like:*** Every scheduled send goes out on time, correctly segmented, and free of broken links or personalization errors.
* The Sr. Brand Manager can hand off a campaign brief and trust it will be built and deployed without rework.
* Growing ownership of segmentation strategy — from executing existing segments to proposing improvements.

 **Compensation:** $40 an hour**Hours per week:** 40

GovPilot provides cloud\-based software solutions to local governments, aiming to make our communities better places to live and work. As a mission\-driven company, GovPilot is committed to creating impactful technology that serves the public good.


We are looking for team members who take pride in their work and seek to consistently improve themselves, their skills, and their knowledge. If this sounds like you–and the type of work environment where you’d thrive–we hope you’ll join us!

Our workforce is global and blended — a mix of full\-time employees, Employer of Record (EOR) arrangements, and independent contractors across multiple countries — and we currently operate through a PEO (Rippling). Experience navigating that kind of complexity, and comfort with the compliance nuances it creates, is essential to this role.

* **HR Operations \& Compliance.** Own day\-to\-day HR operations across the full employee lifecycle — onboarding, offboarding, leave administration, benefits, and compliance with federal, state, and local employment law.
* **Payroll \& Tactical HR.** Be hands\-on with the tactical side of HR, including payroll processing and troubleshooting, benefits administration, and PEO relationship management (currently Rippling).

* **HR Systems \& Reporting.** Own HR systems administration (Rippling), ensuring accurate records, and provide reporting/metrics to leadership as needed.
* **Finance Partnership.** Work closely with the CFO on headcount forecasting, compensation administration, and budget\-related HR matters.

**What You Bring:**

* 5\+ years of progressive HR experience, including prior ownership of HR for a 100\+ person company or a comparable\-sized business unit.
* Strong working knowledge of global workforce structures — FTEs, EOR arrangements, and independent contractors — and the compliance considerations that come with each.
* Direct experience working with a PEO (Rippling experience a plus).

* Excellent judgment and discretion in handling sensitive and confidential matters.

* Experience in a fast\-growing startup or SaaS environment.
* SHRM\-CP or PHR certification.

* Hiring Manager Interview

jobs.title: Customer Operations Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us:**

Trilliant Food \& Nutrition is a leading manufacturer of premium coffees and powdered beverages, proudly headquartered in Little Chute, Wisconsin. With a legacy rooted in quality, innovation, and service, Trilliant delivers branded and private label solutions across retail, foodservice, and e\-commerce channels.

  




Horseshoe Beverage Company, based in Neenah, WI, is a leading ready\-to\-drink beverage manufacturer dedicated to delivering an exceptional beverage experience. By combining industry\-leading talent and cutting\-edge equipment, we drive innovation and consistently deliver the highest quality products to our customers—first and fast.

  



Our brand portfolio includes Victor Allen’s®, Dutch Bros® beverages and Nurri™, our better\-for\-you protein beverage line. We are passionate about beverages – and about building a team that’s just as energized. We invite you to explore opportunities at Trilliant or Horseshoe, to see if your talents and career aspirations may fit with our openings.

  


**Our Core Values:**

  


**Position Overview:**



The Customer Operations Program Manager serves as the strategic operational partner for assigned customers and is accountable for a standardized way of work across customer operational performance, inventory and replenishment insights, service execution, compliance, cost\-to\-serve visibility, and continuous improvement. The role is aligned to the customer not to a brand portfolio and develops deep knowledge of the customer’s systems, requirements, inventory position, replenishment processes, service expectations, and operational priorities.



The COPM connects customer data and operational signals to action. The role works closely with Sales and cross\-functional partners to identify risks and opportunities, provide actionable insights, facilitate root\-cause resolution, and ensure clear ownership and follow\-through.



For this specific customer assignment, the COPM will support Walmart and Sam’s Club and must bring demonstrated replenishment and customer operational experience supporting both Walmart and Sam’s Club. This role requires deep working knowledge of Walmart and Sam’s Club replenishment processes, systems, inventory and POS data, and customer\-specific operational requirements, including hands\-on experience with Retail Link and Nova.

  


**Responsibilities:**


**Customer Operational Partnership**


* Develop an intimate understanding of assigned customers, including customer systems, processes, replenishment requirements, service expectations, operational contacts, and business priorities.


* Serve as the primary operational partner for assigned customers in partnership with the Sales account owner.


* Establish a consistent customer operating cadence, including operational/replenishment reviews, KPI reviews, risk and opportunity discussions, action tracking, and escalation.


* Translate customer needs and operational signals into clear actions and connect work to the appropriate internal partner through resolution.


**Inventory, Replenishment \& POS Analytics**


* Monitor and analyze customer POS, store/DC inventory, in\-stock levels, weeks of supply, order patterns, MABD/fill\-rate compliance, OTIF/service performance, and other customer\-specific inventory and replenishment measures.


* Identify out\-of\-stock risk, excess or imbalanced inventory, replenishment gaps, order opportunities, service risk, and other material customer\-operational concerns.


* Perform root\-cause analysis and provide actionable recommendations to improve in\-stock, inventory flow, replenishment, service, and the cost of moving product optimally.


* Provide order/replenishment recommendations using customer demand signals, inventory position, transit and lead\-time considerations, promotions, seasonality, and customer requirements.


* Prepare customer\-specific replenishment/performance reporting and lead or participate in recurring customer replenishment meetings.


* Develop and improve replenishment tools, reporting, processes, and standard work as business and customer requirements evolve.


* Serve as the customer operations and replenishment subject\-matter expert for Walmart and Sam’s Club, maintaining deep knowledge of customer\-specific replenishment processes, systems, metrics, reporting, and operational expectations.


* Utilize Walmart and Sam’s Club systems, including Retail Link and Nova, to analyze POS, store/DC inventory, in\-stock performance, replenishment trends, order activity, and other customer\-specific operational data.


* Prepare for and lead recurring replenishment and operational performance discussions with Walmart and Sam’s Club replenishment teams, identifying risks, opportunities, root causes, and recommended actions.


**Demand \& Forecast Insights**


* Gather and translate customer POS and/or DC, inventory, replenishment, order, promotional, seasonal, and other customer demand signals into actionable insights for Sales, Demand Planning, and Supply Chain.


* Provide forecast recommendations and proactively identify material changes in demand or inventory position.


* Maintain an active seat at the business table by ensuring customer and replenishment insights inform commercial and operational planning.


**Customer Operational Performance**


* Own visibility to customer operational KPIs, including OTIF, in\-stock, MABD/fill rate, inventory position/weeks of supply, replenishment performance, service performance, compliance, and applicable cost\-to\-serve measures.


* Maintain visibility to purchase\-order\-through\-delivery performance and partner with Customer Service, Logistics, Supply Chain, and other functions to identify systemic execution issues.


* Monitor applicable customer compliance requirements, deductions, chargebacks/fines, and recurring operational failures; coordinate root\-cause analysis, corrective action, and prevention with cross\-functional partners.

We are seeking a highly organized and knowledgeable **CAD/RMS Project Coordinator** to support the successful implementation and delivery of public safety software projects. This role will serve as a key liaison between clients, internal teams, and stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.

The ideal candidate will have experience working within the **public safety technology industry**, with a strong understanding of **Computer\-Aided Dispatch (CAD)** and **Records Management Systems (RMS)**. This individual will be responsible for project planning, schedule management, scope coordination, stakeholder communication, client training, and ensuring projects remain on track from kickoff through implementation.

A strong working knowledge of **CRM systems** is critical to this role, as the Project Coordinator will be expected to maintain accurate project records, document customer interactions, track milestones, and provide clear and consistent status updates.

Responsibilities

* Coordinate and support CAD and RMS implementation projects from project kickoff through completion.
* Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, deliverables, and action items.
* Monitor project progress to ensure deadlines are met and work remains within the defined project scope.
* Identify potential risks, delays, or scope concerns and communicate them proactively to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Serve as a primary point of coordination between customers, project stakeholders, development teams, technical resources, and internal departments.
* Conduct regular project meetings and provide detailed, accurate status updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Document meeting notes, decisions, action items, project requirements, and follow\-up activities.
* Maintain accurate and timely project information within the company CRM, including project status, client communications, milestones, tasks, and relevant documentation.
* Coordinate closely with development and technical teams to communicate customer requirements, track outstanding issues, and support timely resolution.
* Assist with gathering and documenting business, operational, and technical requirements related to CAD and RMS implementations.
* Coordinate and deliver training for end users, system administrators, supervisors, and other customer personnel.
* Develop or assist with training plans, training materials, system documentation, and implementation resources.
* Support customers throughout testing, configuration, implementation, go\-live, and post\-implementation activities.
* Maintain organized project documentation, reports, spreadsheets, correspondence, and supporting records.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with public safety clients while providing a high level of customer service throughout the project lifecycle.
* Support continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance project processes, communication, documentation, and customer experience.

Qualifications

* Experience working with **public safety software**, specifically **CAD and/or RMS systems**, strongly preferred.
* Understanding of public safety operations, workflows, terminology, and agency environments.
* Previous experience in project coordination, software implementation, customer success, professional services, or a related role.
* Strong project planning and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Demonstrated ability to keep projects aligned with established scope, timelines, and deliverables.
* Strong working knowledge of **CRM systems** and the ability to maintain complete and accurate project and customer records.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with agency personnel, executives, technical teams, and other stakeholders.
* Experience conducting customer meetings, documenting requirements, and providing detailed project status updates.
* Ability to work collaboratively with software development, implementation, support, and technical teams.
* Experience training end users and system administrators on software applications.
* Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams.
* High attention to detail with strong documentation, follow\-up, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership of assigned projects, and proactively address issues.
* Customer\-focused mindset with the ability to build and maintain strong professional relationships.

Preferred Qualifications

* Direct experience implementing or supporting **CAD, RMS, Mobile, Jail Management, Evidence, or other public safety technology solutions**.
* Experience working with law enforcement agencies, fire departments, EMS agencies, dispatch centers, or public safety answering points.
* Familiarity with software development and implementation processes.
* Experience with software configuration, testing, data migration, or go\-live support.
* Experience developing or delivering software training programs.

What Success Looks Like

The successful CAD/RMS Project Coordinator will be someone who understands both the operational needs of public safety agencies and the discipline required to manage successful software implementations. You will keep projects organized, communicate proactively, maintain accurate records, anticipate potential challenges, and ensure customers and internal teams remain aligned throughout every phase of the project.

If you are passionate about public safety technology, enjoy working directly with customers, and thrive in an environment where organization, communication, and accountability are critical, we would welcome the opportunity to speak with you.

Benefits:

jobs.title: Creative Project Manager
jobs.description:
### **About Kitsch**


Kitsch is a certified female\- and minority\-owned global beauty brand. Our products are in 32,000\+ retailers across 92 countries. We make essentials that make you feel exceptional.

### **The Role**


We're looking for a **Creative Project Manager** to join our Product Development team, reporting to the VP of Product \& Assortment Strategy. This is a full\-time contractor role, US\-based and remote, Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM PST.


You'll be the link between Creative and Product Development. You'll own the artwork and photography workflow from the first brief to the final file. And you'll make sure our photo assets always match what's really on the shelf.

### **What You'll Do**

* Check every creative brief before work starts. Make sure it has images, copy, specs, and dieline details. Stop incomplete briefs before they slow down the team.
* Own the priority queue for the Creative team. Balance requests from Product Development, Marketing, and other teams so no designer has to guess what's next.
* Track every packaging artwork project from start to finish. Always know its status. Push it forward yourself.
* Be the source of truth for both teams. Share updates early. Clear up confusion before it becomes a delay.
* Coordinate photography samples with the office manager, so samples are never missing or late for a shoot.
* Keep Asana accurate and complete for every active project. Build timelines that match Product Development schedules.
* Spot and fix workflow problems. Bring ideas that save the team time.
* Watch for photo assets that no longer match the real product — a label change, a material swap, a formula update. Catch it first, and manage the fix from request to delivery.

### **What You Bring**

* A knack for turning a messy project into a clear one. You ask the right questions before work starts, not after.
* Backbone. You push back on unrealistic timelines or incomplete briefs, and you find a workable path.
* Comfort translating between two teams with different rhythms and priorities.
* A proactive style. You chase the next step. You don't wait to be asked.
* Rigor with Asana as the single source of truth for your team.
* A talent for building relationships across departments.
* Comfort using AI tools day to day — drafting briefs, summarizing feedback, building templates.
* A "whatever it takes" attitude. If a sample needs tracking down or a task needs updating, you do it.
* Real pride in the work. A packaging error isn't someone else's problem — it's yours to prevent.

jobs.title: Data & AI Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------


We're hiring a Data \& AI Program Manager to support a Fortune 100 technology company. This role sits at the intersection of data strategy and applied machine learning, owning the end\-to\-end data lifecycle that fuels natural language processing (NLP) applications and large language model (LLM) development. You'll define what "good data" looks like for a range of NLP use cases, build the guidelines and pipelines to get there, and partner closely with data engineering, data science, and ML teams to turn high\-quality annotated data into measurable model performance gains.


This is a full\-time position (W2 or 1099 is fine). You would be employed by Cyborg Mobile but placed with our client working full\-time there and reporting to a manager there. We're looking for someone who is a self\-starter, self\-sufficient, and able to execute with little direction. This is a remote position (Washington candidates preferred).


**What You'll Do**
------------------


* Conduct market and user research to understand data needs and expectations across various NLP applications and domains
* Define data specifications, scope, and sourcing strategy for each use case and domain
* Design judgment guidelines and instructions for data annotation, validation, and quality control
* Deliver datasets, schemas, guidelines, and annotations that meet approved specifications, scope, and sourcing requirements
* Manage the end\-to\-end data annotation process
* Analyze data quality metrics (accuracy, consistency, coverage, and diversity) and turn findings into actionable recommendations
* Implement approved data quality improvement actions
* Collaborate with client data engineers, data scientists, and machine learning engineers to integrate annotated data into production pipelines, support LLM fine\-tuning, and evaluate model performance and impact
* Identify data gaps and opportunities; propose new data sources, methods, and features to improve data quality and model outcomes
* Communicate data vision, strategy, and results to internal and external stakeholders, including product owners, engineers, researchers, customers, and partners
* Prepare and deliver data reports, presentations, and demos using client\-approved formats and channels


**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


* Experience in NLP data strategy, annotation program management, or a related data quality/linguistics role
* Strong understanding of data annotation workflows, guideline design, and inter\-annotator quality control
* Familiarity with LLM training/fine\-tuning pipelines and how annotated data feeds model evaluation
* Analytical mindset with the ability to translate quality metrics into concrete improvement plans
* Excellent stakeholder communication skills — comfortable presenting to both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Experience working in large, matrixed corporate environments


**Must Haves**
--------------


* Customer centric
* Good with follow through
* Has skills to build Agents, PowerBI dashboards, Sharepoint list management, coding agents like Codex, Claude Code, Github copilot

jobs.description:

You'll use deep revenue cycle knowledge, Epic Clarity expertise, and advanced SQL to turn complex operational data into accurate, client\-ready insights — partnering with Customer Operations, Central Operations, and client stakeholders to surface trends, uncover defects, and drive action. This is not a traditional reporting role; you'll operate independently, make credible recommendations, and help shape how analytics support operational and client success.  



  

**What you'll do**

* Build, optimize, and maintain reporting and analytics solutions supporting Customer Operations and Service Delivery priorities
* Use advanced SQL and data modeling to extract, transform, and validate data from complex revenue cycle environments

* Translate analysis into clear, client\-ready reporting and recommendations for both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Conduct account and performance reviews that surface actionable opportunities

* Own follow\-up actions and drive execution against recommendations — not just analysis
* Serve as a trusted analytics partner to internal teams and client counterparts

**What we're looking for**

* Strong knowledge of healthcare revenue cycle operations (billing, claims, denials, A/R, payment posting)
* Hands\-on experience with the Epic Clarity data model, ideally in Resolute/Hospital Billing
* Advanced SQL skills — complex joins, aggregations, transformations, and scalable query design
* Experience with Snowflake, relational databases, and reporting tools such as Power BI
* Proven ability to turn messy operational data into reliable, decision\-ready insights
* Track record presenting findings to non\-technical stakeholders and/or clients

**Preferred qualifications**

* Epic Resolute Hospital Billing certification
* Data modeling experience in Snowflake

jobs.title: Member Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**
Calibrate is on a mission to change the way the world treats weight by redefining obesity care as a matter of biology, not willpower. Designed by world leaders in metabolic health, our program combines clinical research, personalized coaching, and lifestyle intervention to deliver lasting weight loss and improved metabolic outcomes. With obesity as America’s largest chronic condition, impacting 175mm adults in a $600B market, we’re closing the care gap by offering the first value\-based model in obesity treatment.

  

Since launching Direct\-to\-Consumer in 2020, we’ve expanded into Enterprise channels to improve access, and our app\-based experience supports members with coaching, tailored education, daily tracking, and community engagement across the four pillars of metabolic health: food, sleep, exercise, and emotional wellbeing.

 **ABOUT THE ROLE**


A Member Care Coordinator sits at the intersection of Member Experience and Clinical Operations. The role of a Member Care Coordinator is to ensure that members receive timely, coordinated, and high quality care; acting as the “glue” between the Clinical, Coaching, and Operational teams. They ensure smooth handoffs between teams, including but not limited to, tracking lab results, medication approvals, and any necessary follow up to ensure members proceed through their journey seamlessly.

 **This is a full\-time, hourly role with a hourly rate of $20\-22 per hour. We are offering three different shifts:**

  

* Monday \- Friday 8am \- 4:30pm ET
* Monday \- Friday 9:30am \- 6pm ET
* Monday \- Friday 10:30am \- 7pm ET

 **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Execute critical clinical administrative workflows focusing on resolving readiness barriers to accelerate members toward provider review and medication access.
* Own member escalations, including issue resolution and member communication.
* Facilitate provider workflow efficiency by preparing clinical documents and proactively triaging member needs for specialty support.
* Facilitate structured handoffs of critical information to Clinical and Coaching teams to ensure timely follow\-up regarding changes in medication, denials, or approved exception paths.
* Engage in cross\-functional meetings and work collaboratively with other departments to improve and maintain a high level of member care.
* Identify and formally report recurring systemic issues, submission errors, or trends that contribute to operational friction.
* Manage the end\-to\-end medication access workflow with complete ownership, including the proactive gathering of relevant clinical data, coordinating with clinicians for additional necessary information, complex Prior Authorization (PA) submission, denial investigation, appeal documentation, final determination and overrides when applicable.
* Proactively contact members via phone and secure message to request necessary information (e.g., previous prescription history, documentation) and deliver clarity regarding complex PA status changes or delays.
* Conduct outbound calls to insurance carriers, PBMs, and pharmacies to obtain specific case statuses, track documentation, and secure approvals.
* Ensure all communication, investigation notes, and PA statuses are accurately logged in the case management system (e.g., Zendesk, MJD) to maintain a complete and auditable member record.
* Initiate and resolve pharmacy\-level rejections (e.g., refill too soon, insurance coding errors, wrong dose dispensed) by conducting outbound calls to dispensing pharmacies and PBM help desks.
* Troubleshoot technical or administrative insurance issues that prevent successful claims processing.

 **BACKGROUND \& EXPERIENCE**

* Completion of a formal medical assisting program is highly valued. Preference will be given to candidates who hold a national certification, such as Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) awarded by the AAMA or Registered Medical Assistant (RMA) awarded by the AMT.
* Familiarity with case management systems (e.g., Zendesk), Electronic Health Records (EHR), and PA/e\-prescribing platforms is highly desirable.
* 2\+ years of high\-volume customer service, call center, or patient advocacy experience, preferably in a healthcare, pharmacy, or PBM setting.
* Demonstrated track record of managing complex, multi\-step processes where follow\-up and persistence are critical to success (i.e., comfortable making multiple calls to solve a single problem).
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the proven ability to handle challenging, escalated calls/messages with professionalism and empathy.
* Ability to meet the position’s attendance and scheduling requirements in a reliable and consistent manner.

 **SKILLS \& ATTRITBUTES**

* Demonstrated proficiency in medical terminology and clinical documentation to accurately interpret patient charts, understand treatment plans, and effectively communicate with clinical providers and payers.
* Strong organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail in documentation.
* Proficiency in interpreting and translating complex insurance terminology for the member.
* Proactive problem solver with a self\-starter mentality.
* Ability to work independently and manage case load effectively.

 **BENEFITS**

*At Calibrate, we’re committed to putting our team members in control of their health. In 2026, we are proudly offering the following benefits:*

* Enjoy a generous paid time off policy, including multiple paid company holidays, wellness days, and floating holidays to support your work\-life blend.
* Medical, dental, and vision benefit options to keep you and your family healthy.
* Calibrate\-funded disability and basic life insurance, ensuring peace of mind during unforeseen events.
* Access to several wellness programs, including a complimentary Headspace membership, and therapy on your schedule with Headspace Care.
* Employee Assistance Program through Principal to receive counseling on a wide range of topics.
* Remote\

jobs.title: Remote Medicare Sales & Customer Support Agent
jobs.description:
**About Silvur**

Silvur Insurance is a rapidly expanding Medicare brokerage firm dedicated to serving credit union members, their friends, and families. Our agents are deeply rooted in the communities they serve—both locally and within the credit union network—delivering support through in\-branch appointments, local seminars, virtual meetings, and educational webinars.

We help members turning 65 navigate Medicare Supplement and Medicare Advantage options, and provide ongoing support during AEP for those enrolled in Medicare Advantage and Part D plans.

Insurance experience but no Medicare experience? No problem. We provide the training, tools, and support you need to build expertise and succeed.

**Position Summary**

This role combines the responsibilities of a licensed Medicare Sales Agent with inbound/outbound customer service and appointment support for members of credit unions nationwide. This is not a general customer service position — the agent is a licensed Medicare sales professional who conducts virtual and phone Medicare sales appointments, handles inbound member calls and emails, manages outbound scheduling and follow\-up calls, and delivers a smooth, compliant, and professional experience across every member interaction. The role also includes post\-sale follow\-ups, upsell outreach, and overflow appointment volume from other credit unions.

This role requires holding an active resident health insurance license in your state of residence. The company will support and sponsor non\-resident licensing in California, Florida, Maryland, Michigan, Oregon, New Hampshire, New York, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington, and Wisconsin, along with completion of required carrier certifications to maintain product knowledge and compliance. While the role is primarily remote, some travel is required (e.g. in\-person member appointments).

**Key ResponsibilitiesSales \& Appointment Management**

* Conduct virtual and phone Medicare sales appointments for credit union members
* Meet and exceed sales targets and KPIs for Medicare Advantage, Medicare Supplement, and PDP products.
* Identify member needs and provide guidance within compliance parameters.

**Medicare Sales \& Member Support**

* Handle the Medicare appointment process end\-to\-end for assigned credit union members, from initial contact through appointment completion.
* Handle inbound calls and emails from members regarding Medicare appointments, and make outbound calls to confirm, reschedule, or follow up.
* As a licensed agent, resolve member questions directly rather than routing them elsewhere; escalate only rare cases requiring specialized carrier or compliance review.
* Provide professional, knowledgeable guidance to members about scheduling, plan options, and next steps.
* Ensure every member interaction is smooth, professional, and compliant.

**Agency Support \& Additional Duties**

* Conduct post\-sale follow\-up calls to ensure member satisfaction and compliance.
* Support upsell calls and other outreach when appointment volume permits.
* Assist with overflow appointment or call volume from other credit unions as needed.
* Collaborate with internal teams on ongoing sales and operational initiatives.

**Documentation \& Compliance**

* Accurately document all member interactions in the agency CRM (AgencyBloc).
* Maintain an active resident health insurance license; obtain and maintain non\-resident licenses in California, Florida, Maryland, Michigan, Oregon, New Hampshire, New York, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington, and Wisconsin, with company support.
* Complete carrier certifications for all required Medicare carriers.
* Ensure all activities comply with CMS rules, HIPAA regulations, and carrier/company guidelines.

**Qualifications**

**Required:**

* Active resident health insurance license in your state of residence, with willingness to obtain non\-resident licenses in California, Florida, Maryland, Michigan, Oregon, New Hampshire, New York, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington, and Wisconsin (company\-supported).
* Ability to contract with all national, regional, and local carriers

**Preferred:**

* Previous Insurance or Medicare experience.
* Strong phone presence and verbal/written communication skills, in person and virtually.
* Comfortable managing multiple calls in a fully remote environment.
* Detail\-oriented, with strong organizational skills and attention to compliance.
* Comfortable interacting with seniors and providing patient, professional guidance.
* Ability to work independently and manage a flexible schedule across multiple time zones.
* Willingness and ability to travel occasionally as needed (e.g. in\-person appointments).

**Compensation \& Terms**

* **Pay:** $30\.00/hr \+ commissions.
* **Classification:** Seasonal role, running through the end of the Annual Enrollment Period (December 7\).
* **Location:** Fully remote, supporting members nationwide. Some travel required

Pay: From $62,400\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Oncology Account Manager
jobs.description:
Looking for a chance to make a meaningful difference in the oncology space? Taiho Oncology is on a mission: to improve the lives of patients with cancer, their families, and caregivers. Our “People first” approach means we also highly value our employees, who work relentlessly to help execute our mission. Taiho’s success is founded on ensuring we always act with accountability, collaboration, and trust. By following these guiding principles, we earn and maintain the confidence of patients, the global healthcare community, collaborators and partners, and each other. Together, we are working on cutting\-edge science and growing our portfolio and pipeline across a range of tumor types to address the ongoing and evolving needs of patients. Advanced technology, a world\-class clinical development organization, and state\-of\-the\-art facilities: these and other resources empower us to innovate and touch the lives of more and more patients. It’s our work, our passion, and our legacy. We invite you to join us.
  
Field
  
**Territory Coverage:** Preferred candidate will reside in the greater Boston Metro area; one hour from Boston proper.
  
  

**Employee Value Proposition:**  

Responsible for the on\-label promotion and sales of existing oncology products within the Taiho Oncology portfolio.
  
  

**Position Summary:**  

In this role, the Oncology Account Manager (OAM) will act as the primary point of contact for customers in the assigned geography. In this role you will meet with customers/health care professionals to understand their practices and provide information on Taiho oncology products and services. The OAM will disseminate product, disease state, and fact statements about other products, across multiple therapeutic areas, while partnering with the commercial business on various cross\-functional initiatives, driving on\-label product adoption and appropriate use. The OAM will drive sales through their face\-to\-face interactions and implementation of innovative tools and analytical processes, while working closely with regional peers, and internal/external matrix teams.
  
  

**Performance Objectives:**  

* Represents the company in a highly professional and ethical manner and fosters the Company’s reputation and image.
* Provides a high level of product expertise and customer service to all accounts.
* Calls on customers (academic \& community setting) in a specific geography, provides on\-label technical and administrative \- information on company’s products.
* Responsible for new account development within assigned geographic territory.
* Builds relationships with physicians, nurses, pharmacy, office staff and key thought leaders in assigned territory.
* Develops and executes a territory\-level business plan with specific tactics aligned to the brand strategy and designed to meet or exceed sales goals.
* Tracks sales activities and reports those activities in the CRM system.
* Serves as a role model for corporate compliance by ensuring all business practices within region are compliant with the Taiho Oncology, Inc., Compliance Code of Conduct, Policies and Procedures and all other applicable laws, regulations, policies \& procedures.
* Conducts promotional speaker programs, lunch and learns, and exhibits in the territory, when permitted.
* Confidently synthesizes and communicates complex clinical concepts in oncology/hematology to a variety of health care professionals (HCPs), including physicians, advanced practice providers, pharmacists, nurses, and others.
* Demonstrates effective account management skills and selling competencies.
* Accountable for driving on\-label product demand to ensure HCPs identify the right patient at the right time.
* Successfully completes all training classes and product certifications.
* Attends and or displays, at all relevant medical congresses and meetings as needed.
* Can develop and execute strategies to reach difficult to access HCP's and accounts in a compliant manner.
* Can effectively deliver on label product messages for several products in person and virtually.
* Demonstrates ability to manage a large geographic territory with overnight travel and occasional weekends.
* Results oriented approach to time and territory management.
* Refers requests for off\-label information to the Medical Information Request process.


**Education/Certification Requirements:**  

* BA/BS degree required.


**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**  

* Minimum 3 to 4 years in pharmaceutical/ healthcare sales.
* Hospital sales experience is a plus.
* Minimum of 2 years of oncology experience.
* Possesses and maintains a valid driver’s license.
* Documented sales success of meeting and achieving sales goals.
* A self\-motivating, can\-do attitude.
* Demonstrated flexibility and willingness to be coached and developed.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively collaborate with internal colleagues.


The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between $170,850 \- $201,000 annually. This pay range is based on the market range for positions of this type. However, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. jobs.title: Telephonic Case Manager
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry\-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting\-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth. **Be part of a team that makes a real difference.**
Job Description:
**This is a full\-time, flexible work from home position and** **can be located anywhere in the U.S.** **RN Compact license and CA RN license required****English/Spanish bilingual is a plus****URAC\-recognized certification in case management (CCM, CDMS, CRC, CRRN or COHN, COHN\-S, RN\-BC, ACM, CMAC, CMC) preferred.** **Perks:** Full and comprehensive benefits program, 24 days of paid vacation/holidays in your first year plus sick days, home office equipment including laptop and desktop monitor, Employee Assistance and Referral Program, and hands\-on workers’ compensation case management training.  

Join our compassionate team and help make a positive difference in an injured person’s life. As a Telephonic Case Manager, you will work closely with treating physicians/providers, employers, customers, legal representatives, and the injured/disabled person to create and implement a treatment plan that returns the injured/disabled person back to work appropriately, ensure appropriate and cost\-effective healthcare services, achievement of maximum medical recovery and return to an optimal level of work and functioning. In this role, you will:* Demonstrate knowledge, skills, and competency in the application of case management standards of practice.
* Use advanced knowledge of types of injury, medications, comorbidities, treatment options, treatment alternatives, and knowledge of job duties to advise on a treatment plan.
* Interview disabled persons to assess overall recovery, including whether injuries or conditions are occupational or non\-occupational.
* Collaborate with treating physicians/providers and utilize available resources to help create and implement treatment plans tailored to an individual patient.
* Work with employers and physicians to modify job duties where practical to facilitate early return to work.
* Evaluate and modify case goals based on injured/disabled person’s improvement and treatment effectiveness.
* Independently manage workload, including prioritizing cases and deciding how best to manage cases effectively.
* Complete other duties, such as prepare status updates for submittal to customers, assist in training/orientation of new staff as requested, and other duties as assigned.


Qualifications:
* **Education:** Associates Degree or Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing or related field.
* **Experience:** 2\+ years clinical practice preferred. Workers’ compensation\-related experience preferred.
* **Skills:** Ability to advocate recommendations effectively with physicians/providers, employers, and customers. Ability to work independently. Knowledge of basic computer skills including Excel, Word, and Outlook Email. Proficient grammar, sentence structure, and written communication skills.
* **Certifications, Licenses, Registrations:**
	+ Active Registered Nurse (RN) license required. Must be in good standing.
	+ URAC\-recognized certification in case management (CCM, CDMS, CRC, CRRN or COHN, COHN\-S, RN\-BC, ACM, CMAC, CMC).
* **Internet:** Must have reliable internet.

Benefits:

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well\-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD\&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Joining our team, you’ll play an active part in helping to deliver meaningful impact. At Oxoid Remel Microbiology, acquired from Thermo Fisher Scientific, we play a crucial role in accurate identification and targeted treatment for diseases, ensuring food and beverage safety, and supporting pharmaceutical manufacturing integrity. Our products and services are designed to meet the highest standards of quality and performance, helping our customers achieve their objectives efficiently and effectively.
  

  

About the Role
  

  

the company’s Microbiology Division (MBD) is seeking a highly motivated Account Manager to manage and grow a large, diverse territory covering the South East part of France.

What We're Looking For
  

  

* Essential:
* Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in a scientific discipline (e.g. Life Sciences, Biomedical Science, Microbiology, Chemistry, or similar)
* Strong interest in a technical, customer\-facing commercial role
* High levels of motivation, drive, and energy, with a proactive approach to achieving targets
* Excellent interpersonal and relationship\-building skills
* Strong problem\-solving ability and commercial curiosity
* Ability to work independently across a large geographical territory
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively within the region

* Desirable:
* Previous sales or commercial experience, particularly in laboratory, diagnostics, or healthcare environments
* Experience with or exposure to public sector tendering
* Knowledge of Microbiology workflows, culture media, or AST (or the ability to learn quickly)
* Experience using CRM systems (Salesforce preferred)

  

* PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES
* Self\-motivated, resilient, and results\-driven
* Confident communicator with the ability to engage a wide range of stakeholders
* Strong organisational and territory management skills
* Comfortable balancing multiple priorities and long sales cycles
* Collaborative team player who thrives in a matrix organisation

  

* TRAVEL

This is an exciting time to join us as we continue to build on more than 100 years of microbiology excellence. With a broad portfolio of instruments, services, and global resources, we’re steadfast in our commitment to helping you succeed. Together, we can cultivate a thriving microbiology culture that supports you today, tomorrow, and for life. Come and be part of what’s next for our company.

jobs.description:
#### **What's in it for you?**



Ready to make a serious impact? Millions of people already rely on Calendly, and we're still in the midst of exciting product growth — it's a fantastic time to join us. Everything you'll work on here will accelerate your career to the next level. If you want to learn, grow, and do the best work of your life alongside the best people you've ever worked with, then we hope you'll consider allowing Calendly to be a part of your professional journey.

### **A day in the life of a Staff Product Manager at Calendly**



This technical product management position will report to the Head of Engineering, Growth and Customer foundations team. We strive to design a seamless product experience that delights our customers. In 2026, Calendly chartered a company\-wide initiative to focus on delivering *Great Customer Experience* \-spanning our Help Center, AI support bot, Automated issue resolution, human support escalations and support engineering. We're hiring a technical Staff Product Manager to work across Product, Go to Market (GTM) stakeholders, marketing, customer support and multiple engineering squads to address real gaps in taxonomy, measurement, and process. This product manager will own the roadmap end\-to\-end and turn a set of disconnected efforts into a durable, multi\-quarter capability that will drive defined growth, product/business outcomes, and customer satisfaction goals.


### **On a typical day, you will be working on**


* **Own the strategy, roadmap, and outcomes** for Calendly's intelligent customer experience, spanning AI support quality, automated resolution, and human escalation
* **Increase automated resolution** by enabling the Support Agent to accurately answer questions and take actions on behalf of customers, while reserving human support for high\-value and complex issues
* **Define and improve AI quality**, including answer accuracy, resolution quality, escalation effectiveness, and the failure modes that prevent customers from getting the right outcome
* **Build the measurement and observability layer** for Agent/Bot Quality Score, automated resolution rate, customer experience cycle time, escalation routing, and customer satisfaction
* **Establish and drive adoption of a company\-wide "supportability contract"** so every new Calendly capability is supportable by AI agents, automation, or human support from day one
* **Close the loop between customer issues and R\&D**, ensuring recurring bugs, product gaps, and support insights translate into prioritized product and engineering actions.
* **Lead across Product, Engineering, AI/Data, Growth, Monetization, Trust \& Safety, Support, and Content Operations** to turn fragmented customer\-support efforts into a durable, scalable company capability
* **Use customer feedback, support data, and experimentation** to continuously improve the experience, prioritize investments, and measure progress against clear customer and business outcomes

### **What do we need from you?**


* This hybrid opportunity is open exclusively to candidates currently residing in California who can commute to our San Francisco Bay Area office
* A minimum of 10\+ years of varied PM experience across both startups and scaled companies, including time spent building 0\-to\-1 platforms or capabilities that other internal teams had to adopt
* Direct experience with AI\-powered agents and/or conversational agents. You have relevant experience and deeply understand where these systems actually fail and what moves answer quality, not just the pitch
* A track record of driving cross\-functional standards or platform adoption across teams you don't manage — this role has real influence\-without\-authority demands from day one
* Strong product sense grounded in support and/or Customer experience data. Comfortable defining metrics from messy or incomplete data rather than waiting for a clean dashboard.
* Ability to build a bold and ambitious vision for the organization with ability to inspire teams to achieve a bold mission
* Experience partnering with GTM (support, success, content) and R\&D stakeholders simultaneously, ideally in a Business to Customer (B2C) and/or Business to Business (B2B) Software as a Service (SaaS), product\-led\-growth environment
* Authorized to work lawfully in the United States of America as Calendly does not engage in immigration sponsorship at this time

### **What's in it for you?**



Ready to make a serious impact? Millions of people already rely on Calendly's products, and we're still in the midst of our growth curve — it's a phenomenal time to join us. Everything you'll work on here will accelerate your career to the next level. If you want to learn, grow, and do the best work of your life alongside the best people you've ever worked with, then we hope you'll consider allowing Calendly to be a part of your professional career.


### **Our Hiring Process:**



Typically, individuals will participate in the following interview process. However, there may be slight nuances given the role and or department we are hiring for. Please keep in mind that individuals can be declined from the position at any stage of the process.


* Qualified individuals will be invited to schedule a phone interview with a member of our recruiting team. This is a great time to ask any initial questions you have about the company or the role.
* Next, we'll put you in direct contact with your potential manager. You'll get a chance to learn even more about life at Calendly, the responsibilities within your role, and the qualities needed to succeed here.
* Then, you will perform an interview exercise, where you can highlight your skills.
* Next, or in parallel, you'll meet with your potential team members.
* Finally, we connect with those you've worked with before, to learn more about the impact you can make, the value you bring, and the best way to set you up for success at Calendly.

Our team’s impact is felt globally as we help patients with cardiopulmonary diseases better understand and manage their health. jobs.title: Lead Consultant, Talent Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
**The Opportunity**
===================


Awayday is a private\-equity\-backed, multi\-brand operating platform in the vacation rental and hospitality services space. We partner with founder\-led and operator\-driven businesses across the U.S. to help them scale while preserving what makes them great locally. Today, Awayday operates across 13\+ states, with 55\+ brands, 1,700\+ employees, and a rapidly expanding leadership footprint.  

  

Awayday is looking for a strategy and operations leader to solve one of the company's most important scaling challenges: building an enterprise Talent Acquisition capability from the ground up.  

  

This is **not a traditional recruiting leadership** role. We are seeking a structured problem solver and builder who can take an ambiguous business problem, break it into its fundamental components, challenge assumptions, design a scalable solution, and drive it through implementation.  

  

To attract the right candidate profile for this need, we've externally titled the role, "Lead Consultant, Talent Strategy \& Operations". Internally, you will be the "**Director of Talent Acquisition**".  

  

The initial mandate is Talent Acquisition, but the opportunity is intentionally broader: this role can become a platform for future leadership across Talent, HR, Strategic Initiatives, or other enterprise functions.  

  

You will step into an environment undergoing significant change. Recruiting is currently distributed across HR Business Partners with contractor support. Your job is to assess what exists, determine what should exist, and build the operating model, processes, technology, analytics, and team needed for the next stage of Awayday's growth.**What You Will Own**
=====================

**Diagnose and Architect**
--------------------------

* Conduct a rigorous current\-state assessment of Awayday's recruiting model, workflows, capabilities, technology, and talent needs.
* Break complex talent challenges into clear workstreams, identify root causes, challenge inherited assumptions, and establish priorities.
* Design the future\-state Talent Acquisition operating model from first principles rather than simply importing an existing playbook.
* Evaluate whether current systems, including UKG Ready, are sufficient for the future state and develop recommendations for the appropriate recruiting technology stack.

**Build the Talent Acquisition Engine**
---------------------------------------

* Create scalable recruiting processes, governance, service levels, intake and calibration practices, sourcing strategies, selection standards, and candidate experience expectations.
* Build a data\-driven recruiting funnel with clear measures of pipeline health, conversion, speed, source effectiveness, quality, and business impact.
* Transition recruiting work from a distributed HRBP\-led model into a dedicated Talent Acquisition capability.
* Build and lead the organization as it scales toward three regional recruiting leaders and approximately 6\-10 recruiters.

**Solve Critical Talent Problems**
----------------------------------

* Initially focus on the leadership and operator pipeline, including Brand Presidents, Regional Vice Presidents, Owner Relations leaders, and other high\-impact roles.
* Develop proactive talent pipelines rather than relying solely on requisition\-by\-requisition recruiting.
* Partner with business and HR leaders to improve role definition, candidate calibration, assessment, and selection quality.
* Support M\&A and organic growth by identifying talent gaps and building repeatable solutions that can scale across a multi\-brand platform.

**Advise and Influence Leadership**
-----------------------------------

* Serve as a thought partner to the VP of Talent, CEO, HR leaders, and operating executives on talent strategy, organizational needs, market dynamics, and hiring decisions.
* Translate analysis into clear recommendations, decisions, and executable plans.
* Create reporting and operating rhythms that give leadership visibility into recruiting performance, constraints, risks, and opportunities.
* Balance speed and action with thoughtful judgment in a fast\-moving, private\-equity\-backed environment.

**What We Are Looking For**
===========================

* A high\-caliber strategy, operations, transformation, or management consulting professional who wants to move from advising businesses to owning and building an enterprise capability.
* Demonstrated success solving ambiguous, cross\-functional business problems using structured analysis and first\-principles thinking.
* Experience designing operating models, processes, systems, funnels, or scalable business capabilities from the ground up.
* Strong analytical orientation and comfort using data to diagnose problems, prioritize work, measure outcomes, and influence decisions.
* Experience leading complex projects or engagements and driving work from problem definition through implementation.
* Executive presence and communication skills sufficient to work credibly with senior leaders while also operating tactically when needed.
* A builder and ownership mentality: energized by creating structure in a chaotic environment and personally driving outcomes.
* Ability to lead and develop teams as the function grows.
* Bachelor's degree.

**Relevant Backgrounds May Include**
------------------------------------


Project Leader, Engagement Manager, Senior Manager, Principal, or comparable roles in management consulting; strategy and operations; sales strategy / sales operations; revenue operations; workforce or organizational transformation; PE portfolio operations / value creation; or internal strategy roles with a strong consulting foundation.**What You Do Not Need**
------------------------


You do not need to have spent your career in Talent Acquisition. Deep recruiting expertise is less important than demonstrated problem\-solving horsepower, systems thinking, leadership potentia

new_jobs.description:
**Why CCI?**CCI Systems, Inc. is an Employee\-Owned Telecommunications Company based in Iron Mountain, MI with 60\+ years of industry knowledge and experience. Our outstanding team\-based work culture and environment has allowed us to grow, develop, and retain long\-term employees. We offer a comprehensive benefits package, competitive pay, flexibility, paid on the job training, professional development, and inspire you to be bold, yet accountable. We value our employee’s hard work and determination and **REWARD** results all while having fun! **Our mission** is to make life better by connecting people through innovative communication systems.

**We are seeking** **Permitting****Project Managers** to oversee all activity with regards to his or her projects including, but not limited to, supervision of employees, project staffing, customer needs, workflow, service level agreements (SLA) adherence, financial performance, timely invoice approval, quality control, and all other aspects of work related to his or her projects. This role is customer facing requiring clear communications skills, both verbal and written, as well as polished and professional personal interactions.

**Responsibilities**

* Liaison between cities and jurisdictions, and build meaningful, long\-term relationships in various markets.
* Guide teams and participate with research and prepare documentation for required permits, right of ways, easements, and land use for telecom projects.
* Create and maintain reports, while tracking progress of multiple projects – for complying with conditions of approvals from municipalities for meeting customer delivery deadlines.
* Obtain all necessary permitting / zoning approval from Federal, State, and local agencies \- Inform other internal functional groups about requirements and regulations of government entities and municipalities to assist with compliance with general conditions of approvals at permit and construction stages of the project, and to meet project timelines.
* Oversees the preparation and submission of permit packages for permit applications adhering to strict standards and regulations.
* Monitor staffing needs in the project group along with maintaining staffing projections.
* Ensure that a Scope of Work is in place for all their projects.
* Create and adhere to revenue, gross profit, accounts receivable, and staffing forecasts.
* Act as the liaison between customers and the internal operations of the project group. This is to ensure that customer’s expectations are met and maintain goodwill for future business.
* Execute project implementation/startup and continuous production management.
* Monitor projects to improve the quality of the work and to reduce the time and cost of project throughput.
* Create and promote the company image through exercising sound and ethical business practices as related to employees, the public and customers. This includes ensuring that service and quality provided to customers is superior to that of our competition.
* Meet regularly with key personnel to ensure that information flows in both directions and to ensure that stated goals and objectives are met.
* Implement corrective actions, as appropriate, on any project to meet cost targets, and completion schedules.
* Ensures subordinates’ abilities are adequate for their responsibilities and develops training and cross training for ongoing skill development.
* Assist personnel with interpreting customer drawings, project documentation, and technical specifications.
* Conducts performance reviews for all direct reports. Does follow up on reviews with substandard grading. Create an environment in which the rating of an average employee is continually challenged. Create goals for employee during review and have mid\-year follow up on said goals.
* Complete invoicing within Service Level Agreements including follow up on unpaid invoices. Make sure purchase orders are in place prior to work startup.
* Perform other related duties as assigned by their supervisor.

 **Qualifications**

* 5\+ years’ experience in permitting design, government affairs or related work in a Utility / Permitting environment in a related industry preferred.
* 5\+ years of Project Management experience in utility permitting or related field preferred.
* In\-depth understanding of NESC 202X code requirements preferred.
* Regulatory Compliance Expertise: Advanced understanding of local, state, and federal regulations related to underground utilities, coupled with the ability to effectively incorporate these regulations into permit drawings,
* Advanced understanding of Telecom OSP Engineering and Construction standards to apply design standards to underground and aerial pole line cable plant, including Joint Use Design, Pole Replacement, Primary Service, and Reliability/Maintenance Design.
* Proven leadership of a Make Ready Team to Perform structural loading calculations using O\-Calc or Spida\-Calc in accordance with NESC and pole owner protocol through inventory and analysis of pole type and class, riser details, attached facility type including weight and diameters, span footages, drip loops etc.
* Ability to create 3\-dimensional model of poles in O\-Calc and Spida\-Calc to provide results to ensure safe and proper attachment to power and telecommunication poles.
* Analytical and observational skills, which demonstrate ability to, plan projects, review/recommend technical specifications, coordinate staffing needs, communicate, and manage all aspects of a project.
* Proven ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high\-pressure environment is crucial.
* Effectively work independently and in a team\-oriented, collaborative environment is essential.
* Proven ability to solve problems creatively.
* Persuasive, encouraging and motivating with the ability to elicit cooperation from a wide variety of sources, including upper management, clients, and other departments.
* Ability to interact with colleag

new_jobs.description:
**About Pulley**


Pulley helps the country’s top architects, builders, and retailers speed up every project in their portfolio. With AI\-powered permitting intelligence and expert guidance, we eliminate costly delays and bring predictability across the full lifecycle of commercial projects.


Today, permitting is the slowest, most uncertain part of building, spread across 19,000\+ jurisdictions with different rules, timelines, and surprises. Pulley gives project teams the clarity and predictability they need to move from planning to opening without delays.


We support rollout programs for brands like J.Crew, Solidcore, and Hibbett Sports, as well as major data center buildouts, EV charging networks, and other commercial projects. Our platform dramatically reduces approval timelines, improves forecasting accuracy, and removes thousands of hours of manual work from design and construction teams.


Founded in 2021, Pulley combines deep permitting expertise with purpose\-built AI from people who have created products used by millions. We’re backed by CRV, Susa Ventures, Fifth Wall, and leaders from Plaid, Segment, ServiceTitan, and Procore.

 **The Role**

***You must be located in*** ***California*** ***to be considered for this role.***

Our in\-house permitting team is a key function for driving fast, reliable permitting outcomes for our customers. In this role, you will:

* Support our lead project managers in delivering great permitting outcomes for customers
* Help conduct permit research with a high degree of accuracy
* Assist in preparing permit plans
* Collaborate with city staff on nuances and ambiguities
* Monitor permit status and ensure timely responses
* Provide feedback to product \& engineering teams to help refine our software platform
* Work with permitting leadership to refine our standard operating procedures

**Who You Are**


To be successful in this role, you are likely someone with:

* 2\+ years in either construction management or architecture, with a focus on project management
* Experience applying for and obtaining construction permits
* Ability to research permit requirements with accuracy
* Comfortable interfacing city staff and navigating administrative processes
* Clear communicator with a strong attention to detail
* Proactive problem solver


Compensation Range: $80K \- $95K

Account Management at Uber means navigating ambiguity, earning trust fast, and solving problems that don't come with a script. In this role, you will own the growth and success of a portfolio of SMB restaurant partners, acting as their primary advisor to unlock the full potential of the Uber Eats platform. It is a high\-stakes environment where your ability to build long\-term partnerships directly impacts the livelihood of local businesses and Uber's mission to move the real world.  

  

The work is fast\-paced and requires a grit\-based mindset; you will deal with shifting priorities, handle tough negotiations, and build lasting partnerships. We are looking for resourceful owners who are energised by the complex reality of Account Management and can stay resilient through the inevitable "no" to find creative solutions for our partners. If you thrive on autonomy and are motivated by seeing the tangible impact of your work on the community, this is where you will grow.  

  

**This is a hybrid role based in San Fransisco (Tuesday \- Thursday). Spanish speaking preference.**
  

  

**What you'll do*** Build and grow long\-term partnerships by understanding what matters most to your restaurant partners \- doing the right thing long term.
* Manage partner portfolios with urgency and discipline, using data\-driven insights to track KPIs and identify opportunities for optimization.
* Navigate ambiguity and complexity to resolve merchant issues, unblock growth, and ensure high\-levels of partner satisfaction.
* Adapt your approach based on market dynamics and partner needs to influence the adoption of new features, marketing products, and services.
* Collaborate across operations, marketing, and product teams to share local market knowledge and shape regional strategies that scale.

**Basic Qualifications*** 3\+ years of experience in account management, operations, sales or customer\-facing functions.
* Ability to negotiate with external partners and overcoming objections to gain commitment.
* Ability to handle high\-ambiguity environments and pivot quickly based on shifting business priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to build and leverage data\-driven insights for portfolio sales lifecycle\-management.
* Fluency in the local language of the market, and professional proficiency in English.
* High school diploma or equivalent.

**Preferred Qualifications*** Proficiency in Salesforce and Google Sheets/Excel for data\-driven decision making.
* Demonstrated problem\-solving ability to solve gaps in merchant processes.
* Stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence without authority.

  

For San Francisco, CA\-based roles: The total on\-target earnings (OTE) range for this position is USD $99,286 \- USD $110,000\. The OTE includes a base salary range of USD $69,500 per year \- USD $77,000 per year and an annualized cash variable incentive target of USD $29,786 \- USD $33,000\.  

  

The cash variable incentive target is based on individual sales performance and its payment is based on the terms of the Sales Incentive Plan.  

  

An equity award and other forms of compensation may be included in the offer. You will also be eligible for various benefits.  

  

**Ready to Ride?**  

  

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook \- it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves \- we'd love to hear from you.  

  

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

### **Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.**

### **The Opportunity**


Are you a results\-driven sales professional with over five years of experience in managing enterprise accounts and a passion for building lasting client relationships? If so, you will thrive in our dynamic remote environment and play a crucial role in driving revenue growth as you collaborate with a dedicated team to deliver exceptional value to our clients in Cleveland and beyond.### **About the Team**


The Advisory Enterprise Account Manager role will be part of the Sales team at Nutanix, specifically located in San Jose, California. This dynamic and diverse team is focused on delivering innovative solutions to enterprise clients, fostering a culture of collaboration and high performance. With a mission to empower organizations through cutting\-edge technology, the team emphasizes customer\-centric service, ensuring that clients achieve their business goals through Nutanix's offerings.
You will report to the Director of Sales, who is known for a supportive and empowering leadership style that encourages individual growth and team success. The work setup for this position is remote, providing flexibility for the new hire, with no requirement to go into the office unless desired.

* Manage a portfolio of enterprise accounts to drive revenue growth and achieve sales targets.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders within assigned accounts.

* Conduct regular business reviews to assess performance, uncover opportunities, and mitigate risks.
* Lead negotiations and close contracts while ensuring compliance with company policies.
* Monitor market trends and competitor activities to inform sales strategy.

### **What You Will Bring**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in enterprise account management or related field.
* Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas.
* Strong communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to build and maintain strong client relationships.
* Effective problem\-solving and analytical thinking abilities.
* Familiarity with remote sales strategies and tools.
* Adaptability to a fast\-paced and changing environment.
* Understanding of market trends and industry dynamics.

new_jobs.description:
**About Airwallex**
-------------------


Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.


Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world\-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. **Attributes We Value**
-----------------------


We hire successful builders with founder\-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role\-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

The Operations team at Airwallex ensures the smooth and efficient functioning of our services and processes. We focus on optimizing workflows, improving operational efficiency, and delivering exceptional customer support. By streamlining operations and implementing best practices, we help drive the company's growth and maintain high service standards. Our team is dedicated to providing a seamless experience for our customers and supporting Airwallex's mission to empower businesses globally.

* Develop and manage on\-shore functional programs and projects that enable US operational and organizational goals.
* Maintain and update customer account settings and pricing throughout the lifecycle of their relationship with Airwallex, ensuring accuracy and consistency across configurations.

**Who you are**


We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.


**Minimum qualifications:**


* A minimum of 3 years of professional experience in the payment industry or operations at a technology company.
* Ability to rapidly understand new products and demonstrate adaptive problem\-solving skills.
* Strong communication skills and customer service consciousness.
* Attention to detail with strong follow\-up and good judgment.
* A strong team player who thrives working in close collaboration with other teams across time zones.

**Preferred qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree or above in Business Administration, Information Sciences, or equivalent.
* Familiarity with reading and parsing JSON formatting, or comfort working with API documentation and sandbox environments.
* Experience with analytical tools such as Excel, Looker, BigQuery, SQL, or similar data and visualization platforms.
